The Germans are attacking! They already breached the outer defence line. Get ready to hold them back!
The German tanks are here! We have information the fascists are using new tank types, watch out for those!
The enemy just sent a new wave!
The fascists are deploying their artillery to help with the assault!
We have received additional reinforcements, try to keep the Germans at bay!
We have received further reinforcements. It's time to drive the Germans out of here and bring their offensive to a halt!
Excellent work comrades, the brutal beast is beaten! This battle - and our inevitable victory - will be remembered for centuries!

Congratulations! You have stopped the enemy as ordered, a major achievement. Your counterattack was a prelude to operation Kutuzov, the massive Soviet counteroffensive which is about to end the German attack and crush German hope for a big victory this year. From now on, the red army calls the shots in this war.

That is not the desired result! The Germans have broken through, and they advance towards the town of Tim, somewhere east of Kursk. If the same thing happens at the south pincer, we’re doomed, and the Germans will surely take us prisoner. But maybe it’s not too late. Gather all the men you can find, and go in again - never give up!

The pincer attack to encircle the Soviet troops around Kursk is in its third day. The northern pincer still hasn’t gained real momentum. This is caused by fierce Soviet opposition and well- prepared defenses.  The Germans push toward Ponyri and Olkhovatka. The area around Ponyri becomes the stage of one of the fiercest battles ever. The central front, under general Rokossovsky, is determined to stand its ground, come hell or high water.  You will be in charge of the defenses in this mission. Make sure you cleverly place some mines between the tank ditches to stop enemy armor from breaking through. If they do, fall back to the second line of defense. Make sure you hold the second line until our comrades of the 13th army are ready to join you for a counterattack.  Make the motherland proud!
Lay down a vast minefield beyond the anti-tank ditches
Defend Ponyri station at all costs!
Drive the remaining Germans out of Ponyri.
Comrades, welcome to Fastiv! The city is crawling with Fascists behind every window, our job is to liberate the city by force!
Show no mercy! Drive the invaders from our city, but be cautious at every corner. The enemy is well prepared for our arrival.
The enemy has barricaded the streets. Some of those rubble piles are too damn high to climb or to blow up. You will have to go around them to get to the city centre!
Reinforcements are at your disposal. Crush the enemy, Comrade. There is no room for defeat.
Tiger tank, coming from the east!
Watch out! There's an anti-tank gun at the end of this street!
Enemy heavy tank destroyer spotted on the southeast!
An enemy tank is approaching from the south!

Congratulations on a job well done! Your veterancy really showed in this battle. It won’t be long until we reach the Polish border, and the liberation of the entire Soviet Union is a matter of time. A favorable report, describing how your actions led to victory, will be sent to HQ. Great job!

That is rather unexpected to say the least! Did you really just allow these exhausted and starving Germans to mess up your attack? We need more resolve and aggression for the next attempt. You should try a different approach. Go back out there and try again.

After a last push on the east of the Dnieper, the Soviets have now regained all territory east of the river. The Germans have decided to construct a defense line on the west bank. Even before the work is finished, the Soviets are already across the Dnieper at Lyutezh, north of Kiev. From there, the Soviets break out to the south in a wide sweep west of Kiev. Brushing any opposition aside, the third Guards tank army leads the way toward Fastiv, a railway node south of Kiev.  In this mission, you will need to use the lessons you learned in Stalingrad to win. Most roads to the center seem to have been blocked thoroughly, so you will need to flank the enemy if your troops are to reach the final objective, which is to eliminate the enemy’s core position in this part of the town.  Good luck!
Drive the enemy out of the city
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Comrades! Today is the day of reckoning for the Hitlerite hordes! Whilst our glorious 5th Guards Tank Army is breaching the Fascist defenses around Memel, we will secure this area and cut them off.
The Germans attacked us last night, and today you are to counter-attack and drive them out of this sector.
Expect high enemy presence, as they will be armed to the teeth!

There are certain key locations in the area which the High Command expects to be captured. I will divert additional troops and resources to your command as you progress with your mission. Good luck, comrades! Onward, to victory!
The Luftwaffe may make an appearance. You must always advance with support from the AA guns. Our forward observers will inform when enemy ground-attack aircraft are inbound.
An enemy column is bound to arrive shortly, from the south! Get ready to greet them!
Good job. You now have access to supplies and logistical vehicles.
Excellent. AT-guns and other support weaponry are now at your disposal.
The Fascists have been driven out of the settlement once and for all! You now have command of our medium tanks.
Nothing can stop our glorious Red Army. And now nothing will stop your heavy tanks, comrade. Use them wisely, we don't have many of them.
Those miserable Hitlerite lowlives will no longer be able to bombard our neighboring regiments. Comrade, I am giving you command of our long-range weaponry reserves.
These Fascists have excellent radio equipment. We will use their equipment to relay ground attack coordinates for our Sturmoviks.
The enemy headquarters are ours. The end of the Fascist occupation is at hand.
The glorious 43rd Army completed the surrounding of Memel. During the offensive, the German 3rd Panzer Army HQ was overrun. Army Group North had been successfully trapped in North Courland.

This failure will prove very costly. The Germans now have the option to either reinforce or evacuate their 3rd Panzer Army! This means we will lose countless more comrades than we already have. You will be in the front echelon when we attack again!
Deploy your reinforcements on the battlefield

Army Group North suffers the unstoppable tide of the Red Army. Stavka proceeds to encircle the city of Memel. In the south, the 43rd Army dashes towards the coast to cut the Germans off from the south. A brutal engagement is about to unfold...
Recapture the depot for acquiring supplies
Capture the first line of defense to get access to AT equipment and support weaponry
Recapture the village of Daukšaičiai to gain access to medium armor.
Secure the road checkpoint to pave way for our heavy tanks.
Take out the German Heavy Artillery position and gain access to heavy howitzers
Seize the enemy communications outpost to establish communications with our air force
Assault the German headquarters and surrounding defenses
You were not able to relieve your comrades in time. The neighboring unit of the 31st Guard Rifle Division has been decimated.
Welcome to the lair of the beast, Comrades. This is Königsberg, the heart of Prussia.
Show no mercy! We need to break through to the railway to assist the 31st Guard Rifle Division.
Chase the fascists from their positions and pave the way to the railway station, commander! Good luck.
Excellent job. Fascist resistance is too weak to stop the red tide!
Good work Comrades! The Königsberg railway system will be useless soon!
Attention! Our neighboring regiment has come under intense fire from Germans on the other side of the railway lines. Assist them immediately, they need to be relieved at once!
Comrades, it's our pleasure to releive you and fight together to crush the fascist resistance. Onward, to victory!
The Germans have clearly reinforced the defences further as we penetrate deeper into the city. We still need to capture the citadel and the city downtown, and this won't be easy.
I bring you the solution to the German fortifications! Stalin's hammers will breach right through their citadel. Show them the way to Hell, Comrades!
Down with the fascist citadel! To victory!
Let's go Comrades, the enemy is close to being crushed!
King Tiger, moving up the road from the northwest!!

Very good! The former East Prussian capital - or whatever is left of it - is ours. This will surely do your reputation a lot of good. You have shown there is no stopping the red army anymore. Morale couldn’t be higher, great job. On to Berlin!

What happened? This is far from the expected result. How is the enemy still able to beat you despite his lack of supplies? You must try again immediately. We can’t afford to be the only unsuccessful siege on the entire front.

By the end of January 1945, Königsberg is isolated. The Germans are not evacuating, instead they prepare to defend the city to the last. In early April, the Soviets start an artillery bombardment that lasts for 4 days. On april 6th the barrage finally ends and the attack begins. The Red army storms the city from all sides. Massive attacks break line after line until they reach the inner city.  In this mission, you will be leading your troops into Königsberg. The Germans have turned the city into a fortress. There are strongholds everywhere; you must take these out first and then take the railway station. Then, you can advance into the city center. You will have to take out the old fortress “Haberberg”, which dominates the old city gate. You will receive heavy artillery to deal with the fortress as soon as it can be spared. Get your troops ready to storm Koenigsberg.  Good luck!
Drive the Germans away from the railway depot.
Eliminate the Germans in the factory area.
Assist the 31st Guard Rifle Division in getting a foothold by the railway.
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Warnings issued about US troops close to HQ:%1%/3
The enemy entered the HQ and you failed to have them eliminated after three warnings.
Fallschirmjäger! We are deployed here to assist the 352nd Infantry Division in holding the Americans back! We are severely outgunned, but well entrenched.
We will defend this position until the rest of our motorised Kampfgruppe arrives.
Spread out, man the guns and mortars, and lay down obstacles to reinforce our defensive line!
The enemy is expected to come from the northern slopes. We need to use the terrain to our advantage!
The hedgerows make it hard for us to see the enemy approaching, but equally allow us to channel the enemy into kill zones.
The enemy has dug out positions on the northern slope, stand your ground and get ready to harrass the enemy on the corner of every hedgerow!
These first enemy squads are probably the scouts. Get ready for some serious attacks!
The enemy artillery ceased fire. I suspect they will use spotters to pinpoint some of our specific positions for bombardment.
The enemy is intensifying the assault toward the west!
Fallschirmjäger! You are doing an excellent job in containing the enemy, but we are struggling to keep up with this massive assault!

Now that the enemy is giving us some breathing space, I'm ordering you to fall back to our HQ on the other side of the valley. The motorised Kampfgruppe should arrive soon to strengthen our lines there.
Additional reserves, as well as artillery strikes, have been made available to you to make sure the enemy does not take Hill 192.

The enemy will try to attack Hill 192 with everything they've got. But this time, the terrain is our advantage; we hold the high ground. They shouldn't even be trying, but these Americans are tenacious as hell!
Watch out! Americans have managed to flank us on the east!
A brilliantly executed defense, Fallschirmjäger! The Americans will learn to fear you, Green Devils. At this pace, we will soon push them back into the sea!

The Americans have brought their mobile artillery forward. They will likely try to hit the HQ. Avoid placing your troops around the courtyard, and take the artillery out if you can afford to send a detachment right now.
A fine display of tactical mastery, taking those artillery pieces out! This is why they call on the Fallschirmjäger; to get the job done!
Enemy artillery inbound! Keep your heads down, Fallschirmjäger!
Here comes the American artillery again! The Americans really want to flatten these hedgerows! Take cover!
The Americans are still inside the perimeter of the HQ! This is your last warning! Have them removed or die trying!
Attention! The Americans are inside the HQ perimeter! I want you to take them out within 2 minutes!
We are very low on AT weaponry, but around the foxholes we have crates with Panzerfausts and other useful tools.

Excellent work! The enemy has been taught a lesson in adaptability and improvisation. Well done, we will be able to contain the Americans in the beachhead. General Schimpf will be very happy to hear about this.

We have failed to hold these hills, and the allies can now walk right into St. Lo! Even though you were facing a very strong enemy, General Schimpf will probably not like the news very much. The Fallschirmjäger are not used to losing battles!

June 10th, 1944. “Festung Europa” is under attack. The allied foothold has expanded in the past 4 days, and now the hills around St. Lô are in the front line. The line north of St. Lô must be held at all costs. Your 3rd Fallschirmjäger Division is setting up positions on the hills in front of St. Lô. The hills are perfect for defense; however, we can’t defend the entire region with the available manpower. The enemy is approaching from the north. Our best bet is to dig in at St. Georges d’Elle.   Set up your line making sure the enemy is being funneled into your killing zones and make sure you defend your AT guns against flanking moves by enemy infantry. Reinforcements are on the way, but they will take some time to get here - if they get here at all. Now, it’s time for your baptism of fire.  Hals- und Beinbruch!
Fortify the defensive line at St-Georges d’Elle.
Hold back the Americans and prevent them from breaching the road.
Defend the HQ, prevent the Americans from taking the hill.
Send a detachment to eliminate the artillery.
Fall back to the HQ and await reinforcements. Time until our reinforcements arrive:
You were unable to keep at least one Panther tank operational!
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Before us stands the town of Le-Mesnil-Tôve. We must seize its vital crossroads if we want Operation Lüttich to succeed!
The town is only lightly defended. I place our Panzeraufklärer under your command! When you have captured the crossroads, our Panzers will roll in.
You should be able to make quick work of the Americans, but you don't have a lot of manpower. Advance cautiously and don't take unnecessary risks.
Ah, look what the Americans left us! What a beautiful half-track!
Good work, Soldaten! I will now dispatch a garrison to hold Le-Mesnil-Tôve. But as for you, unfortunately you will not have much time to rest. I will need you for further tasking in a couple hours!
The Panzergrenadiere from Kampfgruppe Zander have met resistance on the approaches to Chérencé le Roussel in the north. I need you to assist them.
I place some of our armor under your command. Keep the enemy pinned at maximum range, where you will be impervious to their 57mm AT guns.
Enemy counterattack from the direction of Chérencé le Roussel! Deal with those Americans, Herr Leutnant!
Well done Herr Leutnant. Despite the effort, we have not reached Chérencé le Roussel; US defenses have not collapsed, and the constant counter attacks are grinding our offensive momentum to a halt.

..... Attention! The Americans are threatening Le-Mesnil-Tôve from our rear! We cannot afford to lose this position! I order you to turn around immediately! Come back to the town and reinforce the garrison!
We have further bad news. The attack of our neighoring unit has failed and the remnants have returned here after a fighting retreat.
The Panthers need resupply and repairs. Moreover, we cannot afford to lose more of them. Take good care of them, and quickly. We need at least one of them going by the time this is over.
In any case, back to the elephant in the room - we are encircled! Your new objective is to defend these crossroads and fend off any american attacks at sunrise!

We have received our last reinforcements, Herr Leutnant. Some engineers and air defence trucks to bolster your defences. I suppose some AAA is quite welcome, we expect the Americans to attack us from the air tomorrow.
Attention! Enemy sniper on top of that grain silo!

Excellent work! The Oberkommando will be delighted with your leadership. We might win the battle for Normandy after all, after which we’ll probably go back to the eastern front to beat the Soviets. Good job!

This is very unfortunate indeed. We should have been en route to Avranches but we aren’t. How are you going to explain this to the Oberkommando? You will have to regroup and try again, with a bit more vigor!

August, 1944. After the American breakthrough at St. Lô, Avranches has now fallen into American hands. German high command orders a counterattack in the direction of Avranches, hoping to cut off the allied advance. This counterattack, known as Operation Lüttich, aims to cut into the allied flank around Mortain.   You’re a Panzer commander from 116th Panzer Division, and your battalion is attached to Kampfgruppe Schake for this mission. You have orders to advance and take Le- Mesnil- Tôve. Take the village and secure the area. There is little or no information on enemy disposition, so it’s up to your tactical insight and improvisation skill to achieve your goals. Move out immediately, establish contact with the Panzergrenadiers, and wait for further instructions.  Good luck!
Capture the vital crossroads at Le-Mesnil-Tôve
Attack to the north to support Kampfgruppe Zander from 116.PZD
Return to the crossroad to rescue the garrison
Keep at least one Panther operational
Defend the town against the American assault!
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Fallschirmjäger! We need to cross the river if we want to escape the Allied encirclement. The river current makes it impossible to swim with all our equipment attached.
We have spread out into small squads to try to get through the Allied lines. This sector has Americans at every corner, so watch out!
Your first objective is to approach the bridge at Magny. We will see if it's possible to cross the river at this point.
It is up to you to either sneak through or blast your way through. But we are at a severe disadvantage. So pick your fights very carefully.
The shrubbery, the rain and the darkness make it very difficult to spot the enemy. Move carefully and assume that wherever there may be lights, there will be Americans.
This bridge is no good. It's barricaded and swarming with Americans. We also risk them blowing it up if we get into a firefight. We need to find another way!
I hear gunshots! Kameraden, there is another squad being pinned down. Go and assist them!
Fallschirmjäger! It's good to see you. We bring bad news from Magny. The bridge is a no-go. Have you found another way out?
And what is all that artillery gunfire?
... Hmm...  Some of us here speak french and english. I wonder if we could convince the canadians to fire at their own allied positions by the river ford...
Excellent, we have a plan of attack! Go to that manor and get hold of an American Radio back pack.
Excellent work. And there's all the maps laying around, too! Now, we shall transmit the river ford coordinates.
The artillery should have done its work. Fallschirmjäger! Cross the river by the ford!
Good job Fallschirmjäger! The last job for today is to fight your way to the extraction point, let's go!
Everybody, cross over to the north-east side of the river! The Allied forces are arriving in large numbers to our previous positions!
I also see you have wounded soldiers! We will try to get you some medical supplies!
Jawohl Herr Hauptmann! We located a ford in the river, but the Americans spotted us and ruhed a whole damn armored column in to cover it.
The Canadians and Americans want to prove whose artillery is more accurate. They've been firing at multiple coordinates all evening.
We could definitely try, Herr Hauptmann! I believe the enemy is directing the artillery from a radio station inside the nearby manor.

Good work! This result would be called a victory if it wasn’t for the fact we are retreating. But since you succeeded, we have a fighting chance to keep the allies from breaking out in the direction of Paris. Well done!

This is very bad news. We should have gotten out of this situation in order to regroup, but largely due to this failed breakout we’re suddenly a lot more likely to be taken prisoner, and that includes you!

August 1944. The German counterattack at Mortain has failed to achieve its goals, and the allies are breaking out of the bridgehead. The threat of encirclement is real; but even now, Hitler demands new counter attacks in the direction of Avranches. A few days later he finally approves a retreat east. But around Falaise the remnants of no less than 14 divisions, including yours, are being pushed back into a pocket, and the few roads east from Falaise are constantly under attack by allied aircraft and artillery. High command has ordered a breakout by night.   In this mission, the plan for you and the 3rd Fallschirmjäger Division is to break out of the encirclement in small groups. You will command one group, and you are to infiltrate and push through the allied lines, while creating some big distractions to get their attention. Your first assignment is to find a way for the division to cross the river Dives. Once you have found a suitable place to cross, report to 3rd FJ division command, after which further instructions will be issued.  Good luck!
Approach the Magny bridge to perform reconnaissance.
Acquire an American portable radio to give false artillery coordinates in order to eliminate the US forces at the ford.
Cross the river by the fording area.
Escape the falaise pocket by fighting your way to the extraction point.
Bring medical supplies to the wounded soldiers.
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Welcome to the Ardennes, Soldaten! We aim to strike a devastating blow to the Allies, but in running around to find an intact bridge we have almost run out of fuel.
Today you are tasked with seizing the depot at Samrée. From there, we will secure the neighboring town of Dochamps.
Your first objective is to secure the crossroads up ahead, so our armored column can be deployed. After that, lead our forces into Samrée!
Well done, now our armor is here to lead the way. The Americans have some serious firepower, so advance cautiously.

The Americans have an artillery battery nearby which has been bothering us all day. There must be a radio station at Samrée transmitting our coordinates to the artillery. Silence that radioman if you want the bombardment to stop!
Enemy artillery is bombarding us! Move your troops out of there!
Very good, the American radio operator is no more. The enemy artillery has been silenced.
As you make your way to Samrée, make sure to protect the fuel supplies if you find any. We need it!
Excellent job Soldaten! Samrée is ours.
Next we are tasked with heading north and driving the Americans out of Dochamps. We should expect enemy counterattacks from that direction, take a defensive stance for the time being!
We can get further reinforcements, but our columns are pinned down by the American artillery. You must eliminate the artillery battery on the hill, the one that gave us a hard time earlier.
I would advise you to first fend off any enemy counterattacks, and then storm the hill. Do that and receive reinforcements to attack Dochamps with additional troops.
Excellent work Soldaten! The M7 Priests on the hill are all silenced. Our reinforcements are getting themselves sorted and should be here any minute now.
Excellent work Soldaten! Dochamps is ours, and this is a key step in our winter offensive. I can assure you, Iron crosses will be requested for today's accomplishments!
Our reinforcements are here! Now that the American counter-battery threat is eliminated, you get access to long range artillery!

The enemy has very nasty 90mm AA guns which are a threat even to our heaviest of Panzers. Advance cautiously, and watch out for large circular fortifications that could house such guns. We cannot afford to lose armor today!
A large enemy column is approaching from Dochamps towards Samrée! Get ready to hold them back!

The road to Antwerp is open! No matter what happens after this, your achievement will not be forgotten. General von Waldenburg is very happy with your work! The allies will not be able to stop us now that we have an abundance of fuel. Good work, commander!

Well, that didn’t work out as General von Waldenburg planned - and that’s an understatement, to say the least. We’re stuck here, with little chance of achieving any of the goals that were set for your unit. You will have to try again, using different tactics!

December 20th, 1944. Just four days ago, the Germans have sprung a big surprise by mounting a massive offensive in the Ardennes. In a sudden lunge toward the town of Antwerp, German armored columns push west, covered by bad weather. For a few days, the offensive moves with relative ease. But then, the 116th Panzer Division reaches Samrée.   In this mission, you will lead the spearhead of the 116th Panzer Division. The disposition of enemy units is unknown. Our scouts report that the road ahead is blocked; so it seems the Americans know that Samrée is important to us. You have orders to eliminate the roadblock with limited resources. Remember; if you want to get our offensive going again, you will have to take control of Samrée quickly.  Good luck!
Eliminate the Americans at the crossroads for the main column to arrive.
Seize the town of Samrée and resupply fuel
Take out the enemy artillery battery at the hill and acquire further reinforcements
Drive the enemy off the town of Dochamps.
Time until American counterattack at Samrée:
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Attention Fallschirmjäger! There is no time to lose! The Americans have retaken the initiative and are now on the assault!

You are tasked with defending our main line, here in the valley of Thirimont. We will try to pin the Americans down, laying intense crossfire as they hopefully get stuck in the snow. You have several AT guns at your disposal.
The Americans will be here any minute now. Deploy your squads around the emplacements. There is no time to lose!
Enemy artillery just opened fire. Position your men on the camouflaged foxholes and trenches that were prepared. We don't expect the americans to hit those.
What the hell is that! We're getting bombed by airburst artillery!
Here they come! Let us spoil some new year's resolutions! Hold the line!
Well done Fallschirmjäger. Our choice of position and our tactics have decimated the Americans.
Fallschirmjäger! The Americans have slipped through the defences of our neighboring sector! They've swiftly snatched Thirimont from under our noses!
I order you to take back the town and bust any of our troops out of captivity immediately!
Repair as many American vehicles as possible to help us in the assault! Use mortars and AT guns to provide support fire.
Good job, Kameraden! But stop celebrating, we're not done yet. The Americans are storing the captured weapons in the boxes on the stables.
Now, gentlemen! We mustn't let Thirimont fall once again to the Americans, but it's clear our flanks are vulnerable. The only way to ensure success is to defend the town itself.
Fall back and get all of our emplacements to the town; be ready to defend it! Loot all the boxes and supplies, find mines and obstacles. Make Thirimont our unbreakable fortress!
I've ordered our neighboring units in to defend Thirimont with us. Take command of these men!
The enemy has started an intense artillery bombardment on the southern part of town! I expect their attack to come from there!
The enemy is throwing heavier armor at us! Watch out for those sluggers. They can take out our heaviest of tanks at a distance!

Excellent job! Once again you have proven the might of the Fallschirmjäger forces. If only all of our foces would have fought as gallantly as you have, our winter offensive would have reached Antwerp!
Well, those were the main scouting forces. I wonder what the Americans will serve us up with next.

The Americans like to shoot the hell out of everything, and anything that looks even slightly suspicious. Do not set up positions in the open, deploy your men around the camouflaged emplacements the engineers dugout during the night.
Achtung! The Americans have brought Calliope rocket launchers! Keep your heads down!
Well, that wasn't so bad! They actually improved our line of fire! Stupid Americans!
Some of our friendly forces from the collapsing flanks have arrived. I place them under your command! Take Thirimont, Herr Leutnant!

That was very well executed! You have shown the enemy our definition of resilience and grit, and in doing so, you have made your unit look almost invincible. The enemy will probably not try again very soon. Good job!
That did not go as planned, not at all. We have suffered losses we can’t replace, how are we to recover from this blow? You will have to find an explanation for this very quickly.

It is now 1945. The Ardennes offensive is grinding to a halt. The Germans are still very badly hampered by fuel shortages; all along the front line, allied forces have taken the initiative. The weather has improved too, so the allied air forces once more rule the sky above the Ardennes. It looks like things have taken a turn for the worse for you and the 3rd Fallschirmjäger division as well.   You are now in Thirimont, where the Americans are expected to attack soon. It will be your mission to stop them. You and your men have been sent forward from the 3rd Fallschirmjäger Division reserve as replacements for the losses which the 9th Regiment has suffered. The 9th regiment has orders to hold the line at Thirimont itself, which dominates the area. You are to defend this position and where possible, support the defenders on the neighboring hill when the Americans attack. We might be able to get you armored support at some point, but right now a handful of AT guns is all we can spare. So, prepare to defend the village, and await further orders.  Good luck!
Hold the defensive line at the valley.
Recapture the village of Thirimont and liberate the prisoners.
Create a new defensive line around Thirimont
Do not let the village of Thirimont fall to the Americans again.
Time until the arrival of US forces:
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Soldaten! The fate of the Fatherland lies in our hands! Unfortunately, our organisation in this sector is currently rather messy!
We have been sent here to make things right. You are all veterans of this war, and we will rely on your experience to command the troops to victory.
Our primary objective is to defend the town of Attern while the local population is being evacuated, or drafted as part of our local defence forces - the Volkssturm.

So far, our Volkssturm defense forces have performed poorly, commanded by utterly incompetent Gauleiters. Your first task is to find the volkssturm batallion and recruit as many of them as you can. Teach them some real tactics!
We also require you to recover any damaged vehicles or abandoned equipment in order to ready them for use against the Americans.

Members of the Volkssturm! We are what's left of of the 116th Panzer Division. The Americans are closing in! We have learnt how to fight them after the Normandy landings. Join us and you might survive the next enemy onslaught.
Pick 10 Volkssturm soldiers. They will be under your command. I will lead the others.
Herr Leutnant, the enemy is approaching on the main road. Set up an ambush! Use the high ground and let it rain Panzerfausts. There are extra Panzerfausts in the boxes.

The Americans are losing troops and realise that this sector is still hostile. They brought in heavy artillery to obliterate the town. We cannot let them do this! But since they don't know that you have dealt with their column, you can use the element of surprise against them!
Good job! Now fall back to our main defensive line. Morale isn't great. Go to the main square and recruit any troops you see. Prepare to defend Attern.
They're coming. This is our last chance! Make it count!
Excellent job Soldaten. The Americans are backing off.
Soldaten! The enemy has offered terms of unconditional surrender but we have chosen to fight! We haven't fought them all the way from Normandy to here, just to bow down to them now!
We will die defending the Fatherland, like our fathers and grandfathers did. Let our actions today be the tales inspiring our grandchildren! For Germany!!
Thank you for showing respect to my troops. These men all deserved long and happy lives in peace.
What is that thing there? Get that Grille crewed and operational!

Herr Leutnant, you and your men have earned the respect of both me and our American adversaries. It is only fair for you to decide the fate of our unit. We will stand by your decision. Make the choice, Herr Leutnant.
I command this element of the 116th Panzer Division. What do you want?
You want us to surrender, then? Avoiding bloodshed after you obliterated this town?
An Ostwind has been left abandoned in these high grounds. We should definitely repair and re-service it.
Look! An abandoned PaK-40. I think we could make good use of that.
A well positioned pak gun in the hill! Yes, very good. We should use it.
What the hell is that tank coming down the road? It doesn't look like a Sherman. Have the Americans learnt how to build proper tanks?
Soldaten! You have fought bravely and proudly for your country!
In spite of our best efforts, this war is now over for us. Do not feel ashamed, do not feel dishonoured.
Your enemies have feared you. Your enemies have respected you. We have waged our war honorably and gallantly.
You've seen death and you suffered together. But now, you should all return to your families and live the rest of your life in peace.
But do so looking up at the clear skies, and not down at your feet! Germany will recover for sure.
I'm proud to have served with each and every one of you. From the shores of Normandy to the heart of our country, We've defended Fortress Europe together; you made your country proud.
We hereby surrender to the US Armed Forces. There is no other way to survive this bloodshed, this hell!
Well, Sir, that's the best we could do. Your men deserved a proper burial after the fight they put up.
Unfortunately, you do need to come with us now... Soldiers, please escort the german commander back to HQ.
German Soldiers! We are company commanders from the 7th Armored and 99th Infantry. You have fought hard today. With whom do we have the pleasure of speaking?
We have come with an offer which could be of great interest for us all! Your war is lost. There is no need for more bloodshed.
You are surrounded and severely outnumbered. Lay down your arms, and we will take good care of your men. We will give you food and medical attention, and help you bury your dead.
In order to recruit soldiers, move your units close and hover over the soldier you want to recruit. A grabbing icon will appear. Inspect the troops and click to recruit 10 soldiers of your choice.

This is the end. Regardless of the choice you just made, there will be no medals, just a lot of graves. You will need to roll up your sleeves and start building back your country and make sure that a senseless war like this will not repeat itself. Well done!

This failure will have consequences. For one, we cannot prevent being surrounded anymore; furthermore, the road to Berlin is now open to the Americans. Who will tell General von Waldenburg the bad news?

It is now April 1945. A few weeks ago, the Ludendorff bridge at Remagen was captured intact. The Allies also crossed the Rhine at Wesel and Nierstein. As a result, army group B has become encircled completely; the stage for the battle of the Ruhr pocket has been set.   You and the 116th Panzer division have been directed to the area south of Iserlohn. Your first problem is the wide area over which your troops have been dispersed in the past few days; they’re literally everywhere, which makes it impossible for them to act as a unit.   You should group all available troops and see whether you can find any supplies and equipment that was abandoned during yesterday’s fighting, before you can even think about any coordinated actions. Use your experience to make the most of this difficult situation. Do not despair, wonder weapons will soon tip the balance of the war in our favor.  Good luck!
Go to the local Volkssturm forces and recruit 10 soldiers.
Recover and repair at least 2 tanks.
Regroup at the town of Attern and defend it!
Choose: Surrender or fight to the last man
Choose the fate of your troops:
You chose to fight, your soldiers did the ultimate sacrifice for the Fatherland, and the enemy has buried your troops with honours out of admiration for your fighting spirit.

You chose to surrender to the US forces, and spare the lives of your men in a desperate situation against overwhelming odds. The enemy will take good care of your troops out of respect for the tenacious fighting spirit. Soon, Germany will capitulate and the troops will be able to go back to their families.
Excellent! The bridge access seems to have been cleared.
Excellent job soldiers. This elevated position will no longer be a threat when the weather clears up.
Very good. It looks like the fording area has been cleared of hostile troops.
A fine display of tactical excellence, soldiers. The village has been neutralized.
Herr Leutnant, scouts are reporting tank movement towards the village of Glushkovo. Unfortunately, in this weather, the Luftwaffe cannot help you.
Soldiers! We are not done yet! The enemy still holds the other river bank. It’s imperative we break through and seize all the strategic positions.

Herr Leutnant, I have been told that we should expect the village of Glushkovo to be heavily defended. The Soviets are holding the line to prevent the encirclement of their troops between Vyazma and Bryansk.
Reserves and upgraded equipment are at your disposal Herr Leutnant.
Reinforcements are at your disposal! Use them well. Our reserves are limited.
Soldiers! We have orders to clear the road for the attack on Vyazma. But the village ahead keeps us from crossing the Dnieper, and is heavily defended.
We must seize the Dnieper crossings and drive the enemy out of this sector! I expect nothing but the very best from all of you!
Soviet armored reserves are incoming from the east!
Friendly casualties located! Those poor guys really ended up in the worst possible place...

After Glushkovo, the attack on Vyazma succeeded and the Germans marched toward Moscow. However, because of the extreme cold and a large-scale Soviet counteroffensive, an attack on the Russian capital was no longer on the cards. Little were they to know they would have to fight over the same place just a few months later.

Not crossing the Dnieper means not taking Vyazma, and many more casualties for Army Group Centre. This mission result means the northern half of the attack on Vyazma is missing, delaying the end of the encirclement by 4 weeks and stopping the German offensive when it matters most.
Deploy your reinforcements on the battlefield

'Operation Taifun' just entered its third week. Slowed by bad weather, the final push for Moscow starts with a pincer attack on Vyazma. This mission is about the north pincer, trying to cross the Dnieper.
Clear the bridge over the Dnieper
Clear out the Soviet elevated position
Drive the enemy out of Glushkovo
If you are ready, you can skip the defensive preparations by clicking on the right button.
God almighty, this place looked much better the first time we came around.

Shut it. Our situation is no laughing matter. We're about to be surrounded by an overwhelming force with little to counter their relentless counterattack. The only thing playing in our favor is the stellar performance of our close air support.
Herr Hauptmann, reporting in as requested!
Good to have you here! Come closer. You once lead the assault on this sector, today I need you to defend it with the help of our air force.

I expect a full Soviet assault on the north and north-west. We are the only thing standing in the way of the Soviets and the encirclement of our armies. There will be no more retreats, am I making myself clear?
I am assigning you a brigade of our most devastating weapon against the Bolshevik armor - the 8.8cm anti-aircraft guns. You should plan your tactics entirely around these guns.

These men are our artillery signalers. Their flares will mark the way for Hoepner's 4th Army artillery. Use them sparingly. The Luftwaffe squadron ZG26 will support your ground forces. Good luck, Herr Leutnant!
Find some cover! The enemy is about to start a fireworks display!
Do not build defenses too much north from the main road! This area is where the Soviets think we have our defensive lines. I'm sure they will bomb the hell out of it.
As I predicted, they thought our defenses were further north... Well, that's one way to clear our line of fire. Brace yourselves, the enemy will soon make their appearance.
You have at your disposal our artillery signalers. Their flares will mark the way for Hoepner's 4th Army artillery. Use them sparingly.
Aside from air support, we are cut off, so expect no reinforcements. Keep some reserves in the rear to plug holes in the defenses.
I'm sure they did not like our warm welcome. Stay put, the enemy will try to flank us!
Excellent work holding the Bolsheviks in check! However, our neighboring unit was caught ill-prepared. Prepare for an attack from the southwest.
The first Soviet elements have arrived from the southwest!
What the hell is that?! That is no ordinary artillery!!
Herr Lieutenant, take whatever troops are at your disposal and eliminate the threat!

Excellent job! No further assaults have been reported coming our way. Deal with the remaining enemy tanks in the vicinity, see whether we can salvage some of those heavy beasts. They must weigh at least 40 tons!!
Damn, the weather has worsened significantly. Our aviators will not be able to help us in these conditions!
Callsign "Waldkauz" is diving for the requested target.
Callsign "Waldkauz" reports a "Rotte" is being dispatched to the target.
Requesting callsign "Wirsing" to bombard the designated area.
"Wirsing" is underway to bomb your coordinates.
An element of ZG26 is on its way.
Requesting callsign "Wirsing" to strafe the designated area.
"Wirsing" is underway to strafe your coordinates.
Our planes are reporting enemy anti-aircraft artillery in the area. They are reluctant to continue close air support strikes until the AAA is taken out. Find them and destroy them!
The Bolsheviks are back from the north!
The enemy is pushing us once more from the northwest.
Enemy tanks approaching from the northwest!
Soviet armor inbound from the northwest!
Enemy wide armor formation coming from the southwest!
Enemy tanks approaching from the southwestern road!
The Führer had said we'd encircle the Bolsheviks in Moscow by Christmas. I imagine he failed to specify which Christmas that would be.
Shit! Our commander in chief is dead!
The Bolsheviks have entered the premises of the headquarters! They must be driven out immediately, our command is at risk!
Soviets in the vicinity of the HQ! Our commanding officer and our staff are in danger!
Damn it! Soviets close to our headquarters! Our staff must be protected!

The solid stand of the 9th Army along with the heroic contribution of the Luftwaffe caused Konev's forces to fail in their encirclement of Army Group Centre. The counterattack of the Soviets stagnated in February. The new frontline layout led to the Rzhev meat grinder and other battles where, despite terrible losses, the Soviet sacrifice had secured the capital. Hitler then turned south towards the Caucasus and Stalingrad, meaning that Moscow would be securely in Soviet hands and no future attempts to capture it would take place. Operation Typhoon had failed.

Losing this battle means the main body of Army Group Centre will quickly be surrounded and, their supplies dwindling, a catastrophic loss of men and vehicles seems at hand. Not only that; we have lost control over the Dnieper crossings once again. This is even worse than going back to square one.
The enemy is approaching. Prepare the defences!
With Operation Typhoon brought to a standstill, Stavka counterattacks, forcing the Wehrmacht into a defensive stance and pushing them back to positions previously captured in October.
Protect the headquarters at all costs! Keep the staff safe.
Take out the heavy artillery and neutralize the Soviet position.
Take out the AAA for the air support to resume.
Salvage at least one Soviet heavy KV-class tank.
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Soldaten! Listen up!! We have succeeded in crossing the Belbek river and establishing a small bridgehead. But the hardest part is still to come...
We need to break into the main valley positions and clear a way through the minefield for our main force of attack. Only then can we attack haccius ridge, which is our main objective today.
We need to start by advancing eastward and clearing several strongpoints. Los geht's!!
We now control the Belbek valley and can start our attack on coastal battery 30.
We are all set for the attack. We can start off with a frontal attack to take the main battery, or we can try to attack one or more flanks to begin with. It is your choice, Herr Leutnant.

Look out for secondary minefields and AT positions. They may prove dangerous for our advance, be on the loukout for any soviet counter attack as well, the enemy is not going to give up the ridge without a fight...

I am placing under your command our Thor siege mortar. Show those soviets what it means to be under the yoke of the Wehrmacht's heaviest artillery! It will require a whole detachment of resupply vehicles to keep it in operation!
With the additional reinforcements, I expect you to break through the soviet defences and reach the battery. High command will expect no further delays. Annihilate the enemy!
The enemy has also deployed marines from the Black Sea Fleet to reinforce their lines. Beware! These are tough nuts to crack, you will need to throw everything you have at them!
Excellent! Keep up the progress, there is much left to do!
The enemy battery has at last ceased to be. An accomplishment that will live long in our future generation's history books, Soldaten!
Excellent work! The control of this route is of upmost importance, this will stop soviets from being able to get in or out of the battery complex.
Good work, the eastern high ground is ours!
The minefields have been cleared! Our forces can now safely cross through the northern approaches.
You are now tasked with clearing the minefields on the north. This will allow our reinforcements to come through.

Excellent work! The fort has been taken and the entire battery neutralized. The 11th army has its breach in the line and will march on Sevastopol immediately. We will file a favorable report to HQ about your victory at Fort Maksim Gorki!

This is definitely not the kind of outcome we can report to HQ. Our troops were unable to break through, and the attack has come to a complete standstill as a result. You will have to try again after re- grouping, and perhaps using different tactics will help.

The German 11th army is trying to take the last parts of the Crimea that are in Soviet hands. They have taken the Kerch peninsula and now they approach Sevastopol from all sides. The Germans meet stiff resistance from the Black Sea fleet and the 'Separate Coastal Army' under Ivan Yefimovich Petrov. The defenders have dug in everywhere, and they are backed by coastal batteries. Progress is slow, and heavy artillery is brought to the front in an attempt to destroy the defenses and punch through to the city proper.  In this mission, you will lead the attack on battery number 30, or 'Fort Maksim Gorki 1' as the Germans call it. You will have our heaviest siege mortar at your disposal, use it to silence the defenses. The battery's main guns are already out of action. Use your infantry to protect the left flank. Once you have taken out the first line of defense, storm the hilltop and take the fort. We can't allow any more delays in the offensive. It's up to you to make this work.  Good luck!
Clear all of the strongpoints at the first line of defences.
Clear a way through the minefield.
Clear Coastal Battery 30’s Main Battery block.
Clear the Sophia Perovskoy State farm access road.
Greetings! We are on our way to the "Hotu-Tau" pass.
Negative, we're short on time and the Soviets may get there first.
Roger, if we do get back, we will definitely be in need of a drink!
The enemy is here. We need to raise the alarm!
We're under attack! Sound the alarm immediately!
This is shooting! We are under attack, raise the alarm, right now!
Hmm... What is it over there?

Machine gun fire echoed across the mountains for several hours. Slowly the tide of battle turned against Lieutenant Grigoryants and his men. Only 4 men from his detachment made it back alive. The Lieutenants body was one of many that slipped down the mountain slope.

The Soviets, having seen the vulnerability of isolated stations like the one you just lost, will now raid every single strategic point in this mountain range and by the end of 1942, the entire Caucasus might be lost. The 11th Army will very likely get pushed all the way back into the Taman Peninsula.
Our task is to capture "Shelter of the Eleven", ideally without raising the alarm.
They don't expect us. We have the element of surprise.
We should eliminate any enemy patrols along the way.
Correct, our tracks will go unseen. Visibility is poor and we can get close to their patrols without being seen.
They raised the alarm! It's going to get much tougher.
Take defensive positions around the building, I will contact HQ. Our reinforcements will deal with the remaining enemy units.
The Reich will be proud of you soldiers. Excellent work!
The hotel is in front of us. You should quietly silence the perimeter without being spotted.
Capture the building, take out all the Bolsheviks! Kill everyone around the shelter.
The enemy will now make their next move. Gather the squad for a briefing!
Our scouts have spotted Soviet movement five kilometers to the northeast. We must assume that they will try to recapture this position.
We need to get ready for anything. Plant explosives around the area.
Save the explosives for the Bolsheviks!
Don't waste your bullets! We will need every round for the Soviets’ attack!

You have a good supply of mines at your disposal. Mine the four slopes in this sector, and prepare defensive positions. Choose the best defensive positions. We know that the Soviets can attack from 4 possible directions. Place the machine gun points among the stones, to control possible attack directions. Don't let the Soviets take over the Shelter!
All slopes are mined - excellent work. This will give us an additional ace up our sleeves.
We'll hold this position for the time being.
Nice to see you! Can we treat you to a warm drink?
Good luck with your mission! We found several bottles of vodka here, when you get back we can share them.
Any moment now, stay on high alert!
Excellent! Get on the radio to HQ and report the enemy is attacking the "Shelter of the Eleven". Tell them we are outnumbered and that we need reinforcements immediately!
Hold your positions at all costs and buy them some time!
There's too many of them! We need reinforcements.
Find a repair kit and fix the generator immediately!
Damn! They have deployed mortars on the north!
Destroy the enemy mortars immediately or we will be done for!
It looks like these are all their remaining troops. Kill them!
Numerous enemy patrols are to be expected.
The blizzard will conceal our movement.
The area is ours. There are still a few patrols around, but the hotel is secured.
The area is secure! All hostiles have been silenced, the remaining Soviets fled northeast.
The storm has cleared. What a beautiful view.
I am glad we're done here. Frostbite is starting to creep in...
How much longer before the Soviets arrive?
Alarm! Alarm! Herr Leutnant, the Soviets are coming!
We ran into Russian forces on the northwestern slope. We exchanged fire, but we had to retreat. There's too many of them!
The generator is fixed! We can contact HQ now.
HQ is deploying a nearby squad to our position. It will take a couple of minutes for them to arrive.
I think I see what's wrong with it. This is pretty easy to repair.
Herr Leutnant, we could use the generator to power the radio, but it's broken down.
Yes sir! If I remember correctly, I saw one around the houses on the southeastern slope.
Yes sir! I think I saw one around the huts near the hotel.
Yes sir! I vividly remember seeing a repair kit near the hotel.
Soviet infantry coming from the northeastern slope!
Soviet squad spotted on the eastern slope!
Enemies spotted coming from the northern slope!
Enemy approaching from the northwestern slope!
They are retreating! We repelled the attack!
During the 'Fall Blau' offensive, the 'Shelter of the Eleven', a mountaineer hotel, becomes a refuge to the Gebirgsjäger. An attempt to recapture the refuge should be expected.
Take the repair kit to the generator room
Defend the Shelter of the Eleven
August 1942. Mountain Elbrus, near the "Shelter of the Eleven".

Prepare to defend your position. Lay down explosives and use this time to resupply your men. When you are ready, press the button to end the preparation phase.

10th of February, 1943 · Krasny Bor, Leningrad Oblast
Soldiers of the 250th Infantry Division! Listen up!
The Soviet counteroffensive is at large! The bolsheviks are eager to break the Leningrad encirclement and are dashing toward your defences with armor! Everything is at stake!
Today is the day where the Red wave will meet the Blue wall! You already defeated the communists once. I am confident you will do it once more!
Your objective is to hold our rear headquarters at all costs, but it will also be convenient to secure our secondary key objectives:
...and the communications vehicle, which you need to keep operational to maintain radio-contact to call for reinforcements.
I regret to inform you our Anti-tank weaponry is in extremely short supply. However, we have reserves of mines and grenades to deal with the enemy tanks.
The enemy has commenced to bombard our first line. Get to work laying mine-fields and prepare for the enemy assault.
The enemy is approaching. You can tell where they are coming from, as they will use flares to light up the path for their tanks! Hold out until sunrise. No step back!
Our field hospital is endangered so close to the front line. I have ordered its immediate re-location. You must protect it at all costs!
You should consider pulling back your forces into a second defensive line in the village. It has been fortified for the occasion.
The communications vehicle has been jeopardised! Try to get it back in action!
Reinforcements are now at your disposal.
Good job soldiers. You have once again made the Fatherland proud!
The evacuation of the hospital was a success. Our wounded will live to fight once more.
The trucks with the wounded have been hit! This careless escorting will not be tolerated!
Enemy tanks are approaching our headquarters. See to it! They need to be destroyed immediately!
The soviet forces are building defensive positions!
The enemy has a column of prisoners being taken away. I need you to ambush the column and liberate our men!
Good to have our soldiers fighting for the fatherland once again!
Enemy rocket artillery in the area! Stalin's organs have arrived to set the tunes for the sunrise!

Because the blue division held the line at Krasny Bor, the 18th army was not surrounded like the 6th at Stalingrad. But they paid a terrible price; only 1 in five got out alive.  The Germans thought the blue division’s tenacity was unmatched. This seems no more than fair, considering how little they had to defend themselves against the huge odds.

Your failure to hold Krasny Bor has grave consequences; the 18th army has just been cut off from the front, facing the same fate as the 6th army at Stalingrad. Thousands will succumb to injury, illness and starvation. Those that can still walk will be sent to Siberia. This is a dent in your reputation to say the least!

February 1943; the Red army goes offensive in the Leningrad region. Operation "polar star" aims to encircle the German 18th army. One of its goals is to take Tosno, following the road and railroad, both leading straight through Krasny Bor.  Krasny Bor is at the centre of attention in this mission. The initial attack is met by the Spanish Blue Division, who have dug in a handful of AT guns and a few artillery pieces at the village. With enemies approaching from all sides, this battle will be a serious test of your improvisation skills.  Hold your position until it is time to counterattack!
Escort the trucks evacuating the hospital. At least 2 trucks must survive.
Don't let the enemy tanks overrun the headquarters.
Don't let the enemy tanks overrun the artillery battery
Keep the radio vehicle crewed and operational for reinforcements.
Don't let the enemy tanks enter the train station
Attack the next line! We must capture the village before the enemy reinforces the line.
It looks like the pilot survived, we must save him! Push forward quickly.
Maybe the pilot was injured, let's not lose any time.
Great, the village is ours. Prepare to defend it. We must hold the village until the main force gets here.
Find that pilot! Search the whole village, we must save him.
We saw you come down! We did our best to pick you up!
We will take you back to the nearest airfield. Stay close to us, the enemy will soon respond to our attack!
Fine. Move to the village, check each house, kill any enemies you find.
Now we are deprived of the support from our tanks.
Herr Leutnant, our task is to capture and hold the village ahead until our main forces can arrive to reinforce the position.
The fields are mined, our tanks will remain on the road and advance behind you.
You have enough soldiers under command.
Your infantry must destroy the obstacles and fortifications on the road using dynamite. You can find dynamite in the trucks!
As long as you keep your radio operator alive, we can signal the Panzers where to fire.
You have lost control of the village.
Our radio operators did a perfect job. Target destroyed.
Take the village now, or risk a counterattack!
Intelligence reports that Russian troops have begun to move toward the village.
You failed to capture the village. Your superiors will not be amused.
You still haven't found him? Get on with it! The enemy could be here any moment!
Intelligence reports on the appearance of large concentrations of enemy troops, they will begin the offensive very soon! Hurry up!
I will not allow a repeat of Stalingrad. Retreat! They are breaking through to our positions!
Stay calm and hold positions, our reinforcements will break through their positions.
We are leaving, but we will return.
On all fronts, we're losing a colossal amount of armor to mines. This situation is completely unsustainable.
The sappers got held up when their column was destroyed by Soviet strike aircraft.
Affirmative. Stay on the main road for now.
You are suffering many losses. You can call for reinforcements.

This mission, based on Rall’s biography, is the story of a very lucky pilot. In his own words, he was ‘lucky an energetic Panzer commander rushed a column forward and offered a ride to safety’. The battle of Kursk was followed by ‘Operation Kutuzov’, during which the Soviet Army took the initiative for the remainder of the war. Günther Rall was fortunate enough to survive this adventure and the war as well.

As a result of your actions, JG52 has just lost its most talented commander. When the news of the death of Günther Rall reaches his unit, their morale will slump and in absence of leadership, the standards will slip and losses will mount, making reorganization necessary to dissolve the 3rd group of the 52nd fighter squadron.
Don't shoot! I am Hauptmann Günther Rall, I belong to Jagdgeschwader 52. I had to ditch my plane nearby after an engagement!
I am most grateful! If it wasn't for your swift assault, I'd be captured and on my way to Siberia!
Captain Rall's survival chance is %1% percent.
Send a radio message to HQ and request a reinforcement squad immediately!
We have captured the right flank!
We have captured the left flank!
We have broken through the entire first line of defense!
We have stormed the second line of defense!
Take cover! Fire in the hole!
Herr Leutnant! One of our fighter aircraft just crash-landed in the village ahead!
Herr Leutnant, we found the plane, but not the pilot. He must be hiding somewhere, or maybe he was captured.
We captured the last line of defense. Nothing stops us from reaching the village!
Captain, we'll give you a ride back, we need to evacuate you immediately!
There is a Russian tank in the village!
This car looks like it's in running order. Maybe we can use it.
Scheisse! Soviet troops behind us! We are surrounded!
Damn! How are we going to get past these minefields?

We cannot request support fire there. Our pilot is in that area.
Too far, the tanks need to get closer.
Herr Leutnant, I'm ready to transmit the target area. Indicate the desired firing location.
When the battle of Kursk began, expectations were high - and tank busters flew low. Soviet defenses were layered and there were minefields everywhere.
Not yet, we've not finished the previous barrage yet.
Obstacle destroyed. Push forward to the next position!
The tank squad reached the village without loss. Great job, captain.
The tanks are under your command now.
This bloody place is full of mines.
They have maps of the area. They know where the minefields are.
Herr Hauptmann, our Panzers are in position. Your sappers will need to sweep ahead.
Advancing in the open, we risk all our tanks getting blown up before we even arrive at the enemy lines!
The request was denied. The convoy is moving towards the point.
