Soldiers! The enemy is about to assault this position in great numbers. Today we have to stand our ground! The Wotan line must stop the Bolsheviks right here.
They must be preparing for another major assault. Now that they are familiar with our positions, they'll be attempting to smash us to pieces!
Use this time to build new defensive positions! And lay more mines! Expect the Soviets to bombard the current ones!
Excellent work soldiers. Our forward observers have spotted the enemy tank forces halting their offensive. Fend off their remaining infantry! This is our last stand! Make the Reich proud!
Once more you have proven your tactical leadership, Herr Leutnant. I'm proud to be serving by your side.
All the troops have been lost! The enemy has obliterated your men!
The Soviets have breached the industrial area! Our key position has been completely overrun!
The enemy has set foot in the industrial area! You need to drive them out of there immediately, that's an order!
Russians in the factory facilities! Herr Leutnant, drive them out of there now! Or we're lost!
The enemy has entered our industrial position! Eliminate them as the highest priority! If more of them enter the premises, we're done!

Your task is to hold this industrial position at all costs. Expect attacks from all sides! Luckily the poor weather keeps enemy attack aircraft grounded. No reinforcements are available, but we have a solid line of defense at your disposal. You are our only hope in stopping the Red tide!
Armored vehicles are expected from the south...

Enemy infantry regiments crossed the Dnieper and are expected to attack us from the north... we don't know how much longer it will take for them to build pontoon crossings and deploy armored divisions from this sector...
We also anticipate that Ivan will attempt to break through at the village. Grenadiers with short-range weaponry have been deployed there for close-quarters combat...
You have some time to prepare the defenses before the arrival of the first enemy scouts. Dig foxholes, position your men and lay down the mines from the crates by the dispersal area.
The enemy is almost here. Man your positions! If we can hold until nightfall the enemy may call off their assault!
That was not much... I believe we are about to face the true grunt of the enemy attack. Get ready to defend the southern flank!
The Soviets have slowed down their pace. They must be preparing for a decisive blow! Use this valuable time to resupply and reinforce the defenses!
The enemy has deployed heavy artillery on the northwest. They're trying to bombard us from afar!
The Soviets are deploying mortars on the north!
Enemy mortars spotted in the south! They're planning to bomb us out!
The Bolsheviks are coming from the north!
Ivan is assaulting our northern flank!
The Soviet infantry has arrived at our northern positions! We're now fighting on 2 fronts!
Soviet column approaching us from the northwest! On the road!
Ivan has been spotted in the northwest. They're coming along the mud road.
Soviets spotted near the southern road! They're coming this way!
Enemy troops coming from the south, from the main road!
Enemy tank column coming from the south on the road!
The enemy is approaching from the south!
The enemy is approaching from the southeast! Hold them back!
Soviet wave coming from the southeast!
The Bolsheviks scouts are coming from the southeast!
Enemy infantry storming the positions on the southwest!
The Soviets are attempting to breach our positions in the southwest!
Herr Leutnant, it seems the Soviets stopped pressing us further!

The onslaught continued and the Wehrmacht committed all their strength and courage to withstand the Red wave. In Ukraine, the tenacious Soviet forces continued overwhelming the unfinished Wotan line with brute force. Whatever fortifications had been built along the Dnieper were rather subpar, as both materials and labor had been insufficient to build a position strong enough to withstand the might of the Red Army. Nevertheless, in some places, the Germans held the line until well into 1944. Surrounded, undergunned and in spite of all the odds, the Panther-Wotan line bought precious time for the Wehrmacht, for more solid attempts to stop the avalanche of the Soviets and attempt to tilt the balance of the eastern front once more...

Since you were unable to stop the Red tide here, the Red Army can now march west unopposed. They will leave Army Group Centre in complete disarray, and will be able to reach Warsaw before summer. A year from now, still in 1944, Berlin will fall to the allies.
The Germans have been constructing defenses along the west bank of the Dnieper river in an attempt to stop the Red Army's advance. But the Soviets arrive earlier than expected.
Hold the industrial position at all costs!
Welcome to Narva, Herr Leutnant. The Soviets appear to be bogged down in the marshes...

We have two lines of defense, but high command wants us to shift to the offensive using the Tigers from Strachwitz Battle Group. Unfortunately, we don't have any information about the Soviet troops in this area. We could be walking into a trap!
I need you to cross the marshes and acquire soviet documents to give us the intel we need. Get to their headquarters, get the documents, and get the hell out!
We have located the soviet HQ with our scouts. They will spot targets for you. Advance cautiously!
Great job, these are the documents we need. Take them to our high command now!
Good work, the documents and maps will now be studied and translated in detail.
God all mighty! The soviets aren't simply bogged down on the marshes, they're regrouping! We've caught them preparing an armored assault!
The soviets will no doubt accelerate their plans now that they've been caught off guard. Get ready to hold back their armor!
The enemy is on the move! Take command of our first line of defense!

Attention Soldiers! Our forces from the Grossdeutschland division have deployed the second line of defense further back, with more powerful Anti-tank weaponry. We have received orders to fall back and consolidate our line. Move out!!
Herr Leutnant, take command of the Grossdeutschland units and continue holding the line! You are about to meet the tough grunt of the enemy assault!
The Bolsheviks are pressing on! Here come their next attack!
Well done, Soldaten! The enemy has been stopped dead in their tracks!

In spite of the Soviet attack, we must not lose track of our original orders from the Strachwitz Battle Group. We are to take the initiative and attack at once. The enemy is standing down, it's our turn to deal a devastating blow!
Reinforcements from the Strachwitz Battle Group are at your disposal, Herr Leutnant. Drive the enemy back straight to hell!
Attention, the enemy is initiating a flanking attack from the south!
One of your vehicles is being targeted by enemy artillery! Watch out!
Well done, Soldiers. The Bolsheviks will be pushed out of Narva, and our heroic defense will go down history!
Enemy aircraft are trying to spot one of your tanks in the fog! Prepare for an incoming airstrike!

Victory is ours! Your plan has worked; the enemy has given up his offensive. The sector has once more gone quiet. To save our comrades of the Narva garrison, we have to push into the enemy flank next, to turn the tables on this Soviet offensive. You have dealt the first blow, excellent job!

This is more than just unfortunate! Apparently, we should have used our possibilities differently. The Soviets will break through now, which probably means our comrades of the Narva garrison will get surrounded soon. You must try again!

The German army is on the retreat everywhere. In the aftermath of the Kursk battles and Operation Kutuzov, the front line is shifting west so rapidly the Germans can only hope the 'Panther Stellung' will stem the red tide. Army Group North takes up positions on the west bank of the Narva river. In march the situation changes dramatically when the Soviets break through south- west of Narva.   A large-scale Soviet attack by the 59th army into the flank of the German 43rd corps threatens to cut the supply line and isolate the city of Narva.   In this mission, you are in charge of units within the defensive line. The front is quiet and the enemy seems passive. Send out a scout squad to find information. Go behind the lines to snatch whatever information or maps you can get, then return to HQ. Use the information you get back to issue orders, either for defense or counterattack. In any case, you will be in charge and you have no time to waste.  Good luck!
Deliver the documents to our command.
Fall back to the second line!
Push back the enemy and secure the region.
Hold the first line of defense!
Pull back to the second line!
Defend the second line of defense at all costs!
September 25th, 1944 · Carpathian mountains, Belgrade region, Yugoslavia
Hmmm. The command post looks way too quiet... where is our garrison?
I'm certain that something has happened to our soldiers defending the checkpoint, the area is crawling with Yugoslav partisans.

We first need to establish contact with the Gebirgsjäger unit and make sure the checkpoint is safe. Be cautious, both the Yugoslav partisans and the forward elements of the Red Army are active in the area.
Damn it! Partisans spotted! They know we're here, give them hell!
There is no time to mess around. There are many units undergoing evacuation, unite forces and work together to secure this area for the arrival of our forces!
Good job, Soldaten! The checkpoint is ours. This is a strategic location which oversees the entire valley. We must keep it under our control at all costs!
Gentlemen, one of our supply evacuation convoys has arrived to the valley. They need to be escorted to the extraction point southward.
Take them to their destination and keep them safe from the enemy ambushes! We know both Soviet and Yugoslavian forces are active in the area!
Our supply vehicles are overloaded to the brim! With this much weight, they can only reliably travel on roads.
The Allied bombers are pummeling the infrastructure! The bridges are getting bombed to hell!
Soviets! There are enemy Soviet troops in the mix, too!
Excellent work. The supplies are on their way to safety. Now our priority must be to keep their rearguard safe. The Soviets are pressing behind us, we will hold them back!
The last remnants of our armored columns have entered the perimeter. Take command of those forces and keep the soviets busy until our transports are safe! Defend the central checkpoint at all costs!
Brandenburger! We are glad to see you are safe and sound! The Yugoslav partisans have taken the checkpoint, and we lost our commanding officer!
Attention! I hear something... I think we have bombers overhead!
Dust on the horizon! Mobilized troops coming in from the south-east!
%1% out of 3 trucks have been delivered to the extraction point.

That was close! You have shown your leadership, guiding your troops to safety. Maybe it’s not your style to retreat, but at least we live to fight another day. Now, we must get back to our own lines somehow.

This is a bitter defeat. We lost a lot of lives and valuable equipment. Also, the division’s re- grouping orders can’t be fulfilled anymore. The march on Belgrade is going to be too easy for the Soviets!

The German army in Yugoslavia is in trouble. Bulgaria and Romania are no longer allies, and the Soviet offensive puts them under high pressure. Not only that, but all over Yugoslavia they are up against Tito’s Yugoslav partisans as well. The Soviet offensive starts with a fast move across the Danube, splitting the main German force in two. With resistance and attacks on all sides, fighting becomes increasingly difficult. All the action is around German units that are desperately trying to escape the squeeze everywhere, trying to get to the south and to friendly territory.   In this mission, you will be in charge of clearing the bridges across the river Olt. Advance and take the area around the bridges. Hold the area until our trucks arrive from the north. Guide them to safety, which is on the road all the way to the south where it leaves the sector. Regardless of what happens, your objective is to get the majority of your troops out of here in one piece.    Good luck!
Rendez-vouz the Gebirgsjäger and Brandenburger units
Safely evacuate the transport convoy to their destination. At least three trucks must make it through.
Defend the checkpoint from the Red Army assault.
Secret Objective #1: Find the partisan hideout.
Secret Objective #2: Find the underground mining tunnels
Hold the checkpoint until our transports get to safety:
March 10th, 1945 · East of Lake Balaton, Hungary
Soldaten! We have a task of strategic importance ahead! Our forces are conducting a counteroffensive codenamed "Spring Awakening".
The soviet forces are well entrenched, and maybe they outnumber us, but today we have the latest armor and weaponry at our disposal. The bolshevik armor will be no match for our Königstigers.
We are low on supplies. You are to seize the key depots of this area first. Watch out for enemy aviation.
Good job! Our reinforcements will be arriving shortly from the south west.
Excellent work! There are some supply vehicles here, maybe they have some of our ammunition we can take back.
Finally! Some much needed fuel is at our disposal. Let's make the most out of this trophy.
This workshop contains all the tools we need if we run our of our own repair tools. Let's scavenge all we can find.
The enemy HQ is taken out! We have taken a huge leap forward in this fight. In case the enemy counter-attacks, you should get ready!
Good work Soldiers. We've managed to drive out the enemy from all the key objectives. Unfortunately, we don't have the fuel for a next offensive move.
We've been ordered to take all the valuable supplies and hold off any Soviet counterattacks. Our original starting position cannot fall to the enemy under any circumstance!
You are given command of our heaviest and most devastating weapon: the Jagdtiger. Blow those Soviet tanks to bits!
Damn it! Soviet troops are already entering our starting positions! Clear the area immediately!
Excellent work, Soldaten! Once again you have made the Fatherland proud.
Look, a damaged soviet tank stranded in the swamp... I suppose we could use it.
A T-34 has been ditched in the swamp. I bet we can get it repaired!

Well done! You accomplished about everything there was to accomplish in this offensive. In real life, even though the initial advance had been successful, the attacking force was too weak to push much further and the strategic objectives were not met. This marked the last serious offensive of the Wehrmacht in the east.
Oh no! That ruins our chances to get to the strategic objectives - the oil fields. This means the immediate end to our ambitions. It seems we should have tried differently.

On the eastern front, Budapest has been lost to the Soviets in February. The last Hungarian oil reserves available to the axis have also been lost. Hitler decides a counterattack must be conducted. General Balck and the resurrected 6th army are sent to the attack. His forces, among which the IIIrd Panzer Korps, will be part of a pincer attack into the area south- east of lake Balaton. The objective is to reach the Danube river. On march 6th, the main force attacks from the north side of Balaton.   In this mission, you will be put in charge of the attack on the village of Sárszentágota. Your supply state is critical, and therefore your first objectives will be to take the Soviet fuel and supply dumps. Once you have resupplied your units, push on to take the enemy HQ in order to eliminate any threat of a counterattack. Use any enemy equipment you can capture and repair to make the odds a little bit less desperate.  Good luck!
Clear the crossroads for reinforcements to arrive.
Defend from the soviet assault, fall back to the original position.
Secret Objective: Salvage some of the soviet tanks in the swamp.
We set up our positions and are ready to greet our guests. Tell us when you're ready, too. I bet Ivan will show up right after the snowstorm ends, so hurry.
The Soviet columns drive on the main road and railroad. My platoon is on the way to intercept. Please take care of the rest.
This may not be the Juhannus festival, but Ivan's artillery made for a great fireworks display. Good job, everyone!
The Soviets broke your defensive lines.
Here are some of our retreating troops from Suojärvi. They had a tough battle before, and now Ivan is on their heels. We expect them to arrive in the morning.

The retreating troops will take and fortify our main defensive positions behind the river. However, they are not ready to receive the red tide yet. We must slow them down here, while our main line prepares.

Your objective is to set up ambushes along the forest area. The allied units will support you by taking positions along the main road and the railroad. You have to support each other if things get hairy!
It's so cold out here, I can't even sneak into the bushes to answer nature's call.
Maybe so… Simo, what kind of sniper does not use a scope anyway?
This cold is our greatest ally. It will slow down the enemy more than any of our bullets.
I’m more accurate and harder to detect without it!
We lost our positions at Base 4!

You do not have to fight until the last man, or else we will not have any defenders left. Use maneuver defense tactics, pick better positions, and retreat when the moment is right.

Watch out! Ivan has brought his artillery emplacements! They will be very dangerous for our engineers out in the open. We have to destroy them as fast as possible! I am providing you with a captured Soviet armoured vehicle for this purpose. Use it to raid the enemy's rear and destroy this artillery battery.
Excellent job! This artillery battery will not bother us anymore!
I hear the artillery! Lay down!
Artillery strike at the fourth base positions, take cover!
Soviet artillery is firing at our positions at the Dugout Hill, take cover!
The Soviets are firing their long range artillery at our trenches near the rock positions!
Soviet artillery is firing on the hill at the rock positions!
You're right, we stopped their advance. At least for now. Men, you all proved yourselves today. I am very proud of you all. Take some rest, you've earned it.

Our forces have taken and fortified the main defensive line. But the engineers have not placed enough AT mines yet. We have to protect them as long as possible. The more mines they place, the easier the fight will be for us.
Soldiers, scouts report that the Soviet forces are too exhausted to advance! We did it! Let's send their remaining forces to hell!
If necessary, fall back to the rock positions. You don't have to stay in the forest forever.

Soldiers, I received bad news from the frontline at Tolvajärvi. The enemy has broken through there, which means we are the next target. We are the last line of defense in Karelia! Our country depends on us! Let them come - we will stop them right here - let's make history!
Here they come! Men, prepare to fight! Let’s show them what we're made of! For our land, for our families, for our freedom, they shall not pass! The Kollaa line shall not fall!
And here they come again. They are throwing everything at us. We have to hold this line, men. Otherwise, the whole front will fall. I believe in you.
We slowed them down for a little while. Use this time to reinforce your positions and to destroy the Soviet artillery!
Seems like the Soviets decided to give us a little break. I don't think any of them expected this much resistance from us. You are doing very well, men. It's an honor for me to serve with you.
They broke our defensive lines! We have to retreat!
The enemy has captured our positions at the railroad... The Kollaa line has been breached...
The enemy has captured our positions at the main road... The Kollaa line has been breached...
Great job, soldiers! The column is destroyed. However, don't relax just yet. It looks like they only sent a small recon group. Heavier forces will be here soon.
Simo Häyhä is injured! Help him as soon as possible!
Perkele! Simo Häyhä didn't make it... He was such a talented man.

Outstanding work! The Finns achieved what the world thought impossible. The Battle of Kollaa lasted over three grueling months, but through sheer determination and tactical brilliance, the defense held strong. Finland’s resilience has become legendary, giving the nation hope in its darkest hour.

The Kollaa River defense has fallen, and with it, a critical opportunity to stall the Soviet advance. Without a foothold, the Finns face a grim future as the Soviets push deeper into Karelia. This loss will echo throughout Finland, but the fight is not yet over - regroup and find another way!
I'm quite surprised there aren't any Soviet planes overhead. They'd probably bomb us to pieces if they had a chance.
Didn't the retreating troops from Suojärvi bring anything to eat or drink with them? I feel quite hungry and thirsty.

Oh, forgive us, your Majesty! I am sure the retreating troops simply forgot to carry the entire field kitchen on their backs under artillery fire. Look around, we are standing by the river. Just crush some ice and melt it at one of the burning tanks.
Kollaa River, Loimola area, Ladoga’s Karelia
So... Has anyone heard what happened back there in Suojärvi?
Oh man... Only so few troops have made it here so far. And now it's our turn to meet the Reds... Hard to believe just last week I was back home, chopping wood and minding my own business.
I miss my family so much... I would give anything to hear from them. But you know, mail takes forever as the lines are cut. I hope my son manages the farm and helps my daughters.
It's been too rough. Our men got hammered by endless artillery barrages. We were forced to retreat before encountering enemies.
Feels like a different world now. But that's the price we pay to keep our families safe.
Perkele, it seems like the whole population of Murmansk is storming our positions! Retreating to better positions, cover me.
Flamethrowers incoming! They are going to set fire to the forest areas!
Very good, these flamethrowers will not damage our forest anymore.
Perkele, one of those flamethrowers has escaped! We should at least try to kill the rest of them!

It's funny, but the Soviets still haven't admitted the invasion of Suomi. A week ago, when they bombed Helsinki, their propagandists claimed they were dropping food instead of bombs. So let's give them a real treat in return right here, and call it a cocktail party!
We do not have a lot of troops left here, and the enemy is pushing like crazy... When will the main defensive line be ready?
Use this break to resupply, patch yourself up, and shake the snow out of your boots.
Just look how close they placed their ammunition crates near the artillery. I bet one grenade could make a beautiful firework.
We destroyed 4 units already! Where did they get even more?!
It's worth destroying those artillery emplacements as quickly as possible.

You're right, Simo. We have to take advantage of this. At least we have plenty of bottles. Me and the other boys call them "cocktail for Molotov". I am wondering if it's possible to drink them to warm up. I mean, they are still cocktails...
My men are in ambush, waiting for your command to open fire. Let's wait for the moment the entire column is visible.
Change your ambush positions as often as you can. I am sure that each next wave of Soviets will attack the places where they saw you last.
All of them are in sight, come on, aseveljet!
We can't wait anymore! Open fire!
All vehicles are in sight, waiting for your command.

December, 1939. The Soviet army crosses the border and invades Finland in several places.  In the South- East, the Soviets attack Finnish positions at Suojärvi. The Finnish retreat, because their position becomes untenable. They retreat to a position on the Kollaa river; this is considered more defensible than the one at Suojärvi, but the Soviets are still hot on their heels!  A defensive line must be set up very quickly; the 12th division cannot keep retreating to the west.  And so, the Winter War begins in earnest. The situation is as clear as it is serious; you need to stop the Soviets here, or else the entire front line will collapse and your comrades in the west, like at Summa, might get attacked from behind.  Report to your commanding officer immediately, there is no time to waste; do whatever is required to stop this red tide!
I think so. I don't see more of them incoming.
Cocktail for Molotov? I get the part about Molotov, but why is it a cocktail?
I've already lost count of the men I shot. I don't understand why they are advancing so recklessly. What's the whole point of it?
Why do the Soviets send their tanks without infantry cover? Just look at how unprotected these tanks are. It's not that hard to ambush them with the Molotov cocktails onto their engine bay.
Welcome to the Mannerheim line, soldiers! The soviets are about to run into the strongest fortifications our country has to offer!
Our main bunkers are designed to provide cross-fire as the enemy tries to surround them. Anti-tank and machinegun emplacements will make short work of the aggressors!
The enemy is already deploying their artillery. We expect a full-blown frontal assault. Use this time to take positions on the trenches!
The enemy artillery is targetting anti-tank obstacles! They are made out of stone, so they will shatter!  The enemy tanks will undoubtedly roll through the holes.
The aggressors are launching their armored assault! Prepare to hold the line! Focus on immobilising the armor and keep the infantry pinned down!
The enemy is launching another attack!
Good job. Prepare to defend from subsequent enemy waves!
Another enemy armored assault has been defeated. Good work!
The communists are planning to hit us on the western flank! Take positions and spread out your men - we don't want them all blown to bits from the enemy heavy artillery.
The enemy is launching another assault toward the centre!
The soviets are launching another wave on the western flank!
The enemy is advancing on the eastern flank!
Good job, soldiers! You have earned my respect and the admiration of our great nation!
The SJ-5 bunker is designed specifically to bait the enemy into a crossfire. Let them come around it, and open fire from the sides!
Enemy vehicles with automatic weaponry have been spotted coming this way!
The enemy heavy artillery has been taken out! Great job!
If you can afford it, take a trip to the enemy heavy artillery and see if you can take them out!
No! All your soldiers are dead! Unacceptable!
The enemy has penetrated our lines! Surround them and destroy them!
The enemy has brought a huge armored monster. You must immobilise and eliminate it as swiftly as possible!
Sir! Our forward scouts have detected enemy heavy guns on our western flank.
What the hell is that tank? It's a bloody battleship!

Excellent work! You have given the Soviets more than just a black eye, and morale got a real boost out of this battle. If you continue like this, your military career will get a boost too! We have given the population of Viipuri hope, and we’ve taken a lot of equipment from the enemy. That extra equipment will greatly help our situation. This is not over yet!

All that is now left to defend Finland is an unfinished second fortified line, which is much less of a defence than the Mannerheim line was. The Soviets race toward Helsinki and it looks like we’ve been dealt a knock- out punch. All we can do is surrender. This is not how it’s supposed to end!

The USSR has invaded Finland. After initial skirmishes, the main force of the red army arrives at the Finnish main line of defence in december of 1939. This line, known as the Mannerheim line, will have to stop the red army where the main axis of the Soviet attack leads past Summa and toward Viipuri. Bitter fighting ensues. But this is not the Maginot line, and the defenders know this fight will be anything but a walk-over.   In this mission, you will have to prove your leadership by making sure you don’t get flanked while you hold on to Finland’s only defensive line that has a chance of stopping the red army.
Destroy the enemy experimental heavy tank
4th of January, 1940 · Raate road, Kotiranta, Finland
Soldiers, the enemy is stuck on the nearby road. They have no idea we have encircled them, though. Your mission today is to break up the enemy positions and capture as much equipment as possible.

The enemy is freezing, hungry and demoralised. If you isolate the enemy encampments, there is a likelyhood they will surrender. We are outnumbered heavily, but through guerilla warfare we can focus on surprise precision strikes and take down their positions.
Additionally, high command requests we capture as many enemy assets as possible. Try not to blow everything up, and bring the enemy captured vehicles to the designated extraction points.
The blizzard is making it extremely difficult to spot the enemy. Move in cautiously and try to spot the enemy camp fires. It will give away their positions!
Very good, our army will make good use of these assets.
This piece of equipment will surely come in handy.
Splendid. The soviet war machines will be turned against the aggressors!
Great job soldiers, your country is proud of your work today!
Another enemy position has laid out their weapons. Great job!

Well done! With this victory secured, we can now breathe a sigh of relief. Oulu is now out of reach of the Soviets. There is a guy here from HQ, he’s going to take photographs of this carnage now. They requested it so they can use such photographs for propaganda leaflets. These will be aimed at Soviet soldiers, telling them that they will also meet “white death” when they try again.

As a result of the quick breakthrough, the Soviet offensive will reach Oulu and the front is cut in half, heavily compromising our disposition of troops, and probably forcing general Mannerheim to commit his last reserves. It looks like a matter of days before the situation will become hopeless and we may even have to surrender.

After the Finnish victory at Suomussalmi, the red army sends in a rifle division from the east to renew the attack toward the west, past Suomussalmi in the direction of Oulu. The 44th rifle division, however, is confined to the Raate road. After initial contact, a series of Finnish flank attacks begins; this splits the Soviet 44th rifle division in no less than 7 pockets, each of these on the Raate road. The Finns attack the groups one by one.   In this mission you are in charge of attacking the Haukila pocket, using “motti” tactics.
Capture 5 enemy wheeled vehicles and take them to the extraction point
Capture 5 enemy tanks and take them to the extraction point
Capture 5 enemy artillery pieces and take them to the extraction point

Soldiers, the enemy is retreating, but our air force has informed us that their progress has come to a halt. This is a great opportunity to seize a vital piece of equipment and turn the tide of the war!
Your objective today is to capture a set of soviet long range railway gun! Move northward through the woods until you reach the railway tracks and await further instructions!
Avoid unnecessary engagements with the enemy. We do not have the manpower to spare. Stick to the point!

Right, we have located the railway gun following the railway tracks to the east! It seems they are attempting to sabotage it to avoid capture. One of the railway guns has already been blown up! Quickly, overwhelm the enemy and take control of the last remaining gun!
Good job, the gun is in our hands. Thankfully, it comes in loaded with ammunition.

Now we need to securely evacuate the gun, but the enemy presence in the village is threatening the operation. We need you to drive the Soviets off this settlement. Use any means necessary, flatten that village to the ground if you need to!

The enemy seems to be unhappy with the loss of their railway gun. Our observers have picked up an enemy column moving this way to take their asset back. It is imperative you hold your position and prevent the enemy from destroying the gun.
I am dispatching additional reinforcements to bolster your defensive capabilities.
The enemy column has arrived! Wipe them out, all of them!
The enemy is launching an amphibious assault on the southern coastline! Get to the beach and eliminate their landing crafts!
Well, well, what have we here? It seems the soviets lost something.

You’ve done it! We now have two heavy artillery pieces and a trainload of ammo on top of that. This is a big result, promotion can’t be too far away for you now. The railway guns will be towed to our lines tomorrow, and it won’t take long before we’ll be able to use them against the previous owners. Great job!

This is quite a blow. We have missed the opportunity to seize heavy weaponry, let’s hope the enemy won’t deploy it against us. They might re- deploy the railway guns in support of their own fortified line, 30 kilometres south- east of here. We have to try again for sure, there is no way around that, or the entire strategic plan is compromised!

The Finnish army is advancing towards Leningrad. At Ino station, Soviet troops are stranded because the railroad is blocked by a sabotaged locomotive. Among the stranded units are two railway guns and crew. They are supposed to withdraw from the front, but their movement orders have arrived too late. Then, the Finns arrive, and the station becomes the scene of a bitter struggle.   In this mission, you will be in charge of the attack. Use your tactical skill to break the Soviet defensive perimeter. Make sure you take those railway guns intact, we could use them very well!
Push inland towards the railway line
Drive the enemy off the railway and capture the remaining railway gun.
Drive the soviets from the village with the help of the railway gun.
Defend the railway gun from any enemy counter-attacks.

August 1941. The Finnish IV corps marches on Viipuri, while the 8th division crosses the bay and lands south of the town. Very soon, the 8th will try to encircle the Soviet 43rd rifle division at Porlampi. The Soviets offer fierce resistance, trying to break out and regroup.   In this mission, you will have to prove that you know the right “motti” tactics to bring about a swift victory.

Well done! You have completely out- manoeuvred and out- witted the entire Soviet 43rd rifle division, and the enemy is retreating in disorder. We have captured an unbelievable amount of enemy equipment and stocks: 300 artillery pieces and nearly 20.000 shells, over 50 tanks, hundreds of vehicles, and much, much more. Soviet resistance has broken down completely on this front; the road to Leningrad is now open!

The enemy broke out! This means he will fall back to his next defensive line with all of his heavy equipment, and have another go at us. We are supposed to be within artillery range of Leningrad next week, but we might be unable to achieve that. Next time we will have to do better than we did today.
Stay put, soldiers! Do not make any unnecessary movements... The enemy column is approaching, get ready to surprise them!
Let them come into the village before you open fire... You'll be able to grenade them from the houses
Don't let any vehicle get through!!!
Soldiers, support our neighboring detachment to the south-west and intercept the next enemy column!
Check that out, it's an artillery convoy! It would be a shame if those big howitzers ended up in the wrong hands, huh? Try to keep them operational.
Well done. Let's try to re-purpose these artillery pieces right here. They seem to be out of ammo! You can find extra ammunition at the first column you ambushed.
Right then. With these tools at our disposal, the enemy is most certainly doomed. I want you to encircle the enemy from all directions and squeeze the pocket!
I am granting you command of the neighboring infantry company to complete the encirclement of the enemy. In addition, our air force has a couple of bombers standing by. They are now at your disposal.
Yes! Eliminate the soviet vermin! I want to see them burn!
Sir! I can hear another column approaching in the distance, toward the south-west!
Intercept and silence the retreating artillery column.
Capture and re-supply the enemy artillery
Eliminate the enemy forces in the area
Welcome back to Karelia, Soldiers. The Soviets are about to start a large scale assault, and we are to stop them dead in their tracks!
Our main objective is to protect the crossroads to the north. These roads are the bloodline for the logistics of our army. You must defend it at all costs!
The enemy is expected to come from the south, but in this terrain their advance is slow and this gives you time to fortify the positions. Use this time wisely!
The soviet re-purposed railway guns are at your disposal to provide artillery support. We also have the Air Force at our disposal, but the weather must improve for them to be able to operate.
The enemy is approaching! Get ready to defend! Show them how we fight in Karelia!
Another enemy wave is approaching your position!
The enemy is launching another assault!
The Soviets are coming toward us again!
Great job soldiers! The enemy has been held back sufficiently for our armored reinforcements to arrive. I proudly present: the Armored Division.
I want you to take command of a detachment of armored vehicles and drive the enemy off the field. We will accept nothing less than a total retreat to their starting position. Forward, to victory!
The enemy has reached the crossroads! Eliminate them immediately, you are failing to comply with your orders!

What a victory! Your tactical skill is beyond doubt, and once more we have dealt the enemy a huge blow. Instead of getting surrounded ourselves, we’ve now surrounded the enemy. What’s more, the VKT line is still intact and we live to fight another day. We will file the necessary papers for your promotion. Excellent work!

The VKT line has been breached! Soviet armored spearheads race toward the line Imatra-Lappeenranta-Suurpäälä, while the second attack wave has a free hand to attack other VKT line positions in the back, surrounding brigade after brigade and opening up breach after breach. Marshal Mannerheim has no choice but to surrender.

June 26th, 1944. After a Soviet artillery bombardment that lasts for an hour - and which includes waves of ground attack aircraft - a major Soviet offensive bursts forward from Tali village. Somewhere west of Lake Leitimojärvi, the Soviet attack comes to a standstill in front of defensive positions that have been dug out of the hilltops of Kuokkalan Vuoret. They are manned and defended by infantry regiment JR48.   As Soviet tanks move forward aggressively, the situation becomes critical for the Finns, with a real threat of getting surrounded. The survival of the defenders is at stake. Not only that; if this Soviet attack succeeds, it will open up a gap in the VKT line, which would compromise many more units! A counterattack has been organised, and the armored division is being sent forward to arrive in the afternoon.   In this mission, you will command the defence of the hills. You need to hold off the Soviet armor until your own tanks arrive. If you cannot hold the line at the village, use the second line at the crossroads. Use the terrain to your advantage, you have to stop those tanks!
Hold the crossroads at all costs until the arrival of the Armored Division.
Counter-attack with the armored reinforcements and drive the enemy off the battlefield.
Jaegers! Today we have a mission for you of great importance! The fate of the country is in your hands!
The bridge in front of us is of great value to the Germans. They want it because it gives access to the shortest route to Norway.
I need you to seize the control of that bridge and eliminate the enemy garrison! You're the finest our army has to offer - show us what you're made of!
That's it, men! The bridge is ours.
The enemy still remains in the nearby settlement, it's necessary you drive them out of there and secure a solid bridgehead.
Soldiers! The enemy has been driven out but their offensive capability is still extant. You are to fortify the bridgehead and prepare for any possible enemy attacks!

Listen up, astoveri! Intelligence has reported that the German battle group in the area includes Panzer Battalion 211. Expect an attack with their armor, even if they're just some old captured French tanks. Scavenge as many Anti-tank weapons as possible, and prepare for the enemy attack.
Congratulations, soldiers. Your courage and sacrifice are second to none.

Great job! The Germans are now hurrying along the route north, to escape to Norway. From this moment on, it will be like a walk in the park compared to what we’ve been through since 1939. We’ll be home before Christmas, and by then the war will be over for Finland. Congratulations on a campaign well fought and a victory well earned!

This was our chance to live up to the commitment we made to the Soviets, and if they think we’ve failed, they will invade once more - and it won’t be long. Right now, the Germans can take their sweet time to redeploy their troops, and it will be up to us to fend off the red army again.

October, 1944. The armistice with the Soviet Union was signed a few weeks ago, and because of that, Finland has to break diplomatic ties with Germany and expel any German soldiers from Finland. The “Lapland war” begins. Parts of 3rd Division are shipped to Tornio, a port on the Swedish border, with reinforcements to follow soon after. At Tornio, they surprise the German garrison and drive them out of the town. Soon after, more elements of the 3rd division are supposed to arrive.   In this mission, you lead the initial landing party, commanding JR 11. You need to set up a perimeter east of Tornio. Expect Kampfgruppe Kraeutler to counterattack from the east, as they will definitely need the Liakanjoki bridge to get to Tornio, and it’s up to you to defend the bridge against your former allies. Set up a defensive line quickly, and hold the bridge until the rest of the division and the tanks arrive.
Drive the enemy out of the settlement
Resupply your forces and prepare for the arrival of Kampfgruppe Krautler
Destroy the German column and do not let them get away across the bridge.
Fall back to the HQ to strenghten the perimeter
Retrieve as many supply crates as you can
Rescue two 101st airborne men stranded on west beach
Find the guns and neutralize them
Clear out German defenders and capture the battery
Hold your ground until the relief forces arrive from Omaha Beach
Prepare a defensive perimeter for the night
Welcome to France Lieutenant! The success of Operation Overlord depends on you!
Let's go, Rangers! Secure a foothold on the beach!
There are ladders all over the cliffs, use them to get to the top and assault those fortifications!
You may also give the signal to USS Satterlee to bombard the Germans with naval battery fire.
Shit! There's a Kraut 20mm still standing up there! Do something about it before it chews us up!
You've now got a couple of light mortars to help you deal with the entrenched Germans.
What the hell is this? Looks like Jerry's placed some dummy guns in these bunkers. They must've taken the real guns somewhere else!
Lieutenant, those guns can't have gotten far or intelligence would have picked it up. Lead a patrol over to the manor and find those guns!
We should expect the Germans to counterattack anytime. We need to set up a roadblock to keep them at bay.
The first enemy attack has been successfully repelled. But we should be ready to defend this place into the night. Set up defences!
They're bringing in their own mortars and emplacements, watch out!
Rangers lead the way! The Liberation of Europe starts here! I'm proud of you, men!
Colonel - You can now call in limited naval gun support from USS Satterlee!
You must advance at the garrison, search deeper inland. Find the guns and destroy them - good luck  Lieutenant!
Air support is on its way!
Call in naval support from USS Satterlee

You have done an amazing job!  With the relief force from 29th Infantry division and the 743rd tank battalion in place, you can now have someone tend to your wounds and finally take a rest. Your efforts have saved many American lives, surely this will be remembered as one of the pivotal moments of this giant operation. The Liberation of Europe has begun!

We have failed!  This is quite a blow to our hopes of preventing casualties on Omaha and Utah beach. Surely, the Germans will start pounding the beaches with 155 mm shells very soon. There is nothing for it but to try again, failure is not an option. we must take out that battery!
We have cleared the battery but the guns were wooden dummies.
Clear the remaining Germans off the beachhead!

“Operation Overlord” has begun! The largest armada of warships ever to have been assembled is crossing the English Channel towards France. Careful planning and reconnaissance has shown that it will be essential to take out specific parts of the “Atlantic wall” just before the beaches are stormed by the allies. One of them is the German battery at Pointe du Hoc. It is up to the 2nd Ranger battalion to scale Pointe du Hoc and silence the battery.   In this mission, you will land on the small beach and fight your way to the top. Once at the top, you must drive the defenders away and find the battery. You will get support from USS Satterlee and the US air force if needed. This is where the liberation of Europe starts.  Good luck!
Set up defenses around the manor:
Looks like Baker Company landed too close to the machine guns on the cliffs. Destroy the MGs so that they can begin their assault!
Good work, men! Machine guns are down. Baker Company will conduct their assault now!
That Flak gun won't be bothering us anymore!
They are falling back! The Cliffs are now in our control!
Baker Company is getting hammered over there! They won't last much longer without some help. We need to knock out those Kraut mortars and AA guns.
B Company is getting chewed up! Support them from the flank!
All guns have been destroyed! Excellent work, men!
Well done. This Kraut gun will definitely come in handy.
We're expecting a Jerry counter-attack any moment now. Dig in and use whatever you can to hold the line.
Move your asses, get off the beach! Go!
You're easy targets for those Kraut MGs! Get away from the cliff! Move, move!
Take down these mortars before they slaughter us!
We can't hold them here any longer. Everyone, fall back to the trench lines! Grab what you can and fall back!
Damn, they got too many vehicles, we can't hold them on the open ground! Fall back to the rear trenches!
Jerry is pushing our line! Hold your ground!
Hey hot-shot, leave some glory for the rest of us.
We don't know what the enemy will throw at us, be prepared for anything. Set up defensive positions overlooking any choke points.
More Kraut tanks! We don't have very many rockets for the Bazookas, so make every shot count!
Kraut mortars! Get to cover, incoming!
Looks like Jerry has brought up mobile Flak guns! Everyone, get to cover!
Hold tight, men! We can't let 'em get this ground! The reinforcements are on the way!
That's it, there's nowhere else to go, we'll make our last stand here!
Well look who decided to show up. Cavalry's finally here. Well done boys, I'm proud of each and every one of you. Rangers lead the way!
Dog Company will begin their assault once you're ready. Just give the word.
Lieutenant, over there! Looks like there are some paratroopers pinned down. They're a ways away from their drop-zones, we need to help those boys out!
The enemy has captured your defensive positions.
Fallback to the positions on the beach
Fallback to the farthern trench line
Eliminate the machine gunners on the cliff
Remaining machine gunners on the cliff: %1%
Secret objective - Repair the broken anti-air gun
July 11th, 1944 · Les Hauts-Vents, West of Pont-Hebert, Normandy
Break the positions of Fus Bat 275
Select your Doctrine for the mission:
Break the positions of Pz Gren Rgt 902
Break the positions of Gren Rgt 984
Welcome to Normandy, 3rd Armored. The situation ain't pretty.
Our advance across the river Vire was rather slow but now we're approaching Hauts Vents. Fighting among the hedgerows is extremely difficult.
Our reconnaissance team has established this command post just off the main road towards Pont- Hébert. We are waiting for reinforcements.
The first Sherman has arrived, let’s hope the rest makes it here quick.
That was close but I hear tank engines in the distance. Prepare to defend our HQ at all costs, the Germans are trying to take us by surprise!
We held our own, but the neighboring platoon got hit hard. They need our help to push back the Germans. If the Krauts overrun them, they will push into our rear, that cannot happen.

We have captured Germans from the Panzer Lehr Division, which means they are probably in the area. The prisoners also told us that the 275. Infantry Division has set up defenses everywhere, you have to advance extremely carefully.
Our scouts also have reported an 88 battery set up along the ridge overlooking the roads, we need to take it out if we want to push towards Hauts Vents.
All in all, we've extracted from the prisoners the positions of all the main German forces in the area. I order you to take them all out.
Reinforcements have arrived. This is all that we can commit to this attack right now. Make the best out of it, Lieutenant!

Congratulations! You stand victorious after a hard-fought battle. The attack on St.Lo and Operation Cobra are next. This battle has proven once again that we are an unstoppable force, and the Liberation of Europe is only a matter of time. Keep it up!

These hedgerows really are hell on earth right now. Apparently, we need different tactics or a bit more luck. We can’t be fazed though, and we need to repeat the attack or Operation Cobra has failed before it has even begun. General Watson’s orders were very clear!
The first Shermans have arrived, let’s hope the rest makes it here quick.
I hear tank engines in the distance. Prepare to defend our headquarters at all costs, the Germans are trying to take us by surprise!

We held our own, but the neighboring platoon got hit hard. They need our help to push back the German tanks that took the crossroads to the west of our position. As long as they hold it they can push into our rear, don't let that happen.
Re- establish the line & destroy the German tanks

July 1944. Since the D-Day landings in June, your advance has been steady, if a bit slow; but gradually, the bridgehead widens and deepens, as does the crisis for the Germans. The main objective of general Bradley’s advance is to take the area around St. Lô. To get there, the road to St. Lô must be cleared first.   You will be leading your troops into the hedgerows today. A spotter plane has reported enemy movement nearby. This might be the Panzer Lehr division! They might be trying to counterattack, better sound the alarm and brace yourself. Stand your ground until our main force arrives, and stand by for further orders.  Good luck!
Take positions among the hedgerows around the HQ.
Hold off the German column and await reinforcements
Re- establish the line & destroy the German push

Target out of our range, you're gonna have to give us new coordinates.

Excellent work soldiers! This victory shows the tenacity of the US Rangers, keeping calm in the face of overwhelming odds. This hill seemed impregnable at first sight, but you took it anyway. People will remember this battle for a long time. You certainly made your mark as a commander today!
This turned into a bad day somehow. If we fail to take this hill, our sole advantage for the next battle is lost. This can’t be happening to the 2nd Rangers, you must try again!

December 1944. You have been in Europe for half a year now. Progress has been steady and the allied advance seems unstoppable.   Today, just like on D-Day, you will be taking an enemy position on high ground, a crucial hill that would give us the high ground in the upcoming battle for the Hürtgen forest. On your map, it’s named Hill 400, near Bergstein. You must gather intel on the enemy position first, and then decide how you’re going to take this hill. When you have control of the area, you must reinforce the position, set up radio communications, and defend  against potential counterattacks. Only when you have radio contact, will you get access to artillery support. Use it to your advantage whenever you can.  Good luck!

The Krauts understand that they are sitting ducks against our bazookas and grenades the moment they stand still. They plan to overwhelm us and break right through our lines without stopping. Do not let that happen. Not a SINGLE german tank is to cross this bridge. Understood?
Well done Soldiers. The Germans are now on the defensive. That will show them!

Germans! Germans! The damn Krauts are coming in half-tracks and armor!

Great job, General Rose will be very pleased! Now, let’s get the press guys up here and show them the results of this fight; we seem to have plenty of cameramen here. If they managed to get some footage of the action, this fight might become symbolic for the Battle of Cologne someday. Who knows?

What happened? Now that we have the Pershing tank available, we should be able to win a battle like this. We desperately need to take all of Cologne this side of the river, but if we can’t get past a few enemies, that’s going to be very hard. For the next attempt, maybe you can change tactics?

March 1945.   After the bitter fighting in the Ardennes and the Hürtgen forest, the allied drive to the Rhine seems unstoppable. They advance on a wide front with relative ease. Moving along its streets with your tanks, you will need to be very careful not to break your tracks or get stuck in the piles of rubble. Today, you are tasked to fight your way into the city, and to advance all the way to the Rhine River. Keep your tanks safe by clearing the houses on both sides of the roads. Watch out for snipers while you advance to the central station near the cathedral and the bridges. You’ll likely run into enemy tanks as well.   If the need arises, we can send some of our brand new heavy tanks forward. For now, get ready to move.  Good luck!

Thirty minutes ahead of them, the pathfinders of the 101st US airborne division are already on their way! They are the first American troops to land in German-occupied France. Several waves of para-drops and troop-carrying gliders will bring in the airborne assault troops. 6th of June, 1944. The 82nd is on its way to France. In the early hours of D-Day, they will jump over Normandy!    There’s a simple yet ambitious objective for the 505th battalion: take the village of St. Mère-Église and do it quickly. The drop zone is just northwest of the town, so the plan is to assemble and then move southeast toward it.    Shortly before 2 AM the 505th jumps into the night, oblivious to the fact the formation is flying much higher than it should.  Good luck!
Escape the German sentries and find your Commander!

The successful assault at Brécourt Manor, in part, gave the troops at Utah Beach a relatively easy landing. This assault has become a classic case study in military training for engaging a superior enemy force. Colonel Robert Sink, who commanded the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment, put forward Dick Winters for the Medal of Honor. Still, it was downgraded to the Distinguished Service Cross due to a policy allowing only one Medal of Honor per division. Despite this, both Winters and Lieutenant Speirs would later gain global recognition for their actions at Brécourt Manor and in subsequent battles.
Easy Company, Listen Up! Our boys on Utah Beach are getting hammered by that Kraut artillery. Drop everything except weapons and ammo!
