Today, the largest airborne operation in military history takes place. Nearly 17.000 airborne troops will be dropped East of the river Rhine in Germany.  You have just landed behind enemy defenses in front of Wesel, with orders to secure the area in support of the planned Rhine crossing. The crossing is to take place in three different locations today; you will interfere with any enemy activity in the Wesel area, to prevent enemy attacks on the crossings.  Your unit, the 6th Airborne Division, will be in the very first wave. Your orders are to secure the nearby train station and to clear the way for the next wave.
We have restored our reputation, and the operation to cross the Rhine is a huge success. Let’s see Jerry deal with this blow!   Thank you for playing the "Finest Hour" campaign!
My word, that was not at all as expected. We should have held the enemy away from the river crossings; but because we failed, those will probably turn into a bloodbath.Regroup and try again!
On your feet, Sam, they're pushing through!
Ammo running low… We won’t be holding this junkyard here for long.
A Jerry’s tank incoming! Bloody hell… We don’t have PIATs, do we?
Our little Locust has arrived to support us! Just in time. Keep holding the ground! Crew, destroy this tank!
Nice hit! Come on, Jerry, we have plenty of shells for all of you!
Alright, we’re good for now. Let’s check where we are on the map…
What the hell is doc up to? Go help our wounded lads, they have one foot in the grave!
For God’s sake, don’t be like a shy nurse! Tend to the wounded! They won’t hold for long!
Good, now back to fighting! There should be some crates near the glider, top up your ammo!
For Christ's sake, we could have saved them!
They’ve destroyed our Locust! I reckon it’s just us now against Jerry.
Believe it or not, this is the first time our pilots skipped on the ale and they dropped us exactly on target. We have to destroy Jerry's anti-air and secure the nearby rail station.
Right in front of us there is a first anti-air position. Knocking it out will save our gliders so they can drop us some toys. Makes sense to take it out first.
If the maps are still up to date, there should be more ack-ack guns at the railway station. You know the drill, lads.
Another company landed to our west. They will support our little offensive.
Those signs slightly concern me. Good thing we have mine detectors in the supply box at the glider, making it walk in the park. Defusing will take a lot of time, though.
Hold fire, hold your damn fire! They’re surrendering!
One gun down! Let’s get on to the other one!
Both guns have been destroyed! We should get some reinforcements from our landing zone very soon.
Heads up, there is an 88’ to the north of us at the railway station! Try to avoid its field of view for now.
Look at that, this tank destroyer should be still working. But how can we get to it?
Did I ever tell you that it was my dream to become a train driver? Well, because it wasn’t. Still can't believe some people like them and not get bored.
I better get promoted for this…
Blimey, this thing is pristine! Well, beside the gun but it’s negotiable with a good repair kit.
You know, I sort of envy them.
These Germans. Their chances of getting home alive are better than ours.

Look at this boy… I wouldn’t give him 16. At his age, I used to shoot a slingshot at abandoned buildings windows and run away from the coppers… This poor kid was running around with a damn rifle a half hour ago… What is the world coming to?..
At your age? Do you mean the period between the Roman Empire and the Hundred Years' War?
Knock it off, will ya? I’m not that old actually. Turned 32 recently. This morning, more specifically.
Are you having a laugh?! Keeping this secret the whole time? Happy birthday, my ancient friend.
Captain, we just got a message from the US 17th! They’ve managed to secure the bridge but Jerry is pushing ‘em very hard. They’re requesting assistance from us.

Alright lads, the celebration is postponed. Sergeant Shelton, you stay here and make sure not a single Jerry holding a weapon comes close to the railway station. Try to find something to drink while we’re away. I’ll take the second platoon and move towards the Yankee positions.
Got it, Sir. Good luck. See you on the other side.
The Yanks have managed to capture the bridge on the Issel river but Jerry is counterattacking. We need to support the GIs quickly.
Spread out and watch the flanks! Our ground forces should be here soon. Hold your ground!
They are not as cooperative as the ones at the railway station, ha?
What the… Holy shit, where did they come from?! Watch the southern flank!
Someone man this HMG, that machinegunner is down!
Watch out, enemy tank from the east!
Eyes on the south-east! They’ve brought another tank!
German mortar is firing at us from the east! Shut it down already, God dammit!
What in Gordon Benett are you looking for in that shed, Mac? Come and help us already!
You scrooges cannot be that greedy, can you, lads?
There's no way on this earth you downed all the bloody bottles yourself!
For the love of God, if you’re doing this shit again, I’m gonna leave you to rot with the other Boche!
Oi, hello my dear friend, nice to see you. It won’t be long, unfortunately. But we’ll have a very good time together, you have my word. Yeah, I’m coming!
Christ alive, what have I done to deserve such punishment? Get rid of that crate and help us, God dammit!
The engine doesn’t start, I need you to help us fix it. These poor airborne blokes are still under Boche’s fire and we have to get to this bridge as soon as possible.

You lads are mean to me, you know that? I try my best to keep the… What did they call it?.. Ehm… Esprit de corps! Yeah, the esprit de corps thing! I put my heart into this crew so we’re all blythe together.
And nobody has ever appreciated what I do for you, lads. I mean… I’m not the most bonnie lad in the world, so they’ve told me… But… Nobody?
Mate, listen… Not a soul has ever had a sip of your booze except yourself.
God help us… Just shut your mouth and get to work, Mac!
Aight men, we’re good to go! Tank crews, take your positions! Infantry, all aboard! Time to save our paras!
I see enemy armor! 200 yards, north-east! All units, load AP! Drivers, take cover behind the tank wreckages!
Targets incoming from the north! Gunner, traverse!
I see more tanks from the north-west!
Where in the hell do they come from?!
More enemy tanks from the north, get ready!
I think that was the last of them. Brilliant job, gents. Let’s keep moving to the Issel bridge. If someone needs a repair, do it now. There won’t be a way back.
They’re still alive! We should help them!
Priority targets to the south-west! Three tigers! Everyone, load APDS!
Just look who showed up at the last moment! Hold your ground, we’re not falling back!
All armoured targets have been destroyed! Brilliant job, gents.
They’re falling back! I’ll be damned… We did it… We did it, lads…
So I reckon that’s where our war ends too, my friend. Did you manage to find the hush-hush supplies I asked you?
Well… I’m afraid I did not.
I’m extremely disappointed, Sir Fletcher. You will only get the next promotion over my dead body.
Lieutenant Leonard Hall, this is my modest company. You’ve made it really good there.
It’s Captain Samuel Rowse who is thankful to your men till his last day.
You lads look sad. Think I know how to cheer you up.
Mac, get your arse over here! And bring the thing you’ve found!
Sir, with all due respect… But I think we just need some rest. It’s been a really tough day with all the…
Blimey… You've read our minds, lieutenant!
Sir, I’ve told you I would share my findings. Let me introduce some of Jerry’s homemade booze to you, lads. Tastes like a cough syrup but still warms you right up.
This is private MacKenzie, we call him just Mac. He is a good bloke from a far northern village. Don’t worry, most of us can’t understand him anyway.
I don’t think that will be a problem. I bet we all speak Scottish after a few shots.
Alright, let’s find out what that Jerry booze tastes like. Cheers!
Panzer down! Gunner, service the next target!
Ambush! AT-guns, 170 yards to the north!
Watch out, watch out, AT infantry from the west!

Good job men. Hold here in case the English decide they want this back. The column will now continue moving.
Oh god! Where did they come from?! We need to stop them!
I’ve received word that some heavy guns are being brought forward! We need to hold out as long as we can while they set up the guns!

Gute arbeit, männer. The Tommies are running away! They won't come back anytime soon while the Luftwaffe is in the sky!
Herr leutnant! Our forward Aufklärer spotted some Tommies dug in around the town ahead of us. What are your orders?
Panzer Alarm! Tanks coming from the North-West!
Their armor is too thick! We're doing nothing to them! Aim at the tracks and immobilise them!
The British artillery is trying to hit one of our Acht-Acht's! Move it to a new position before they zero in on it!
Take grenades and explosives from this crate!  Use anything you can find! We must stop them!
Planes incoming!... Wait, it's our boys! They will show them now!

Just 11 days ago, Europe went from ‘Sitzkrieg’ to ‘Blitzkrieg’ with the rapid advance of German troops into the Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg.   Taking everyone by surprise, the Germans quickly cross the Meuse River at Sedan just days later and push West.   Exploiting the element of surprise, the 7th Panzer Division has been on the move for 8 days straight. Right now, you are approaching Agny, south of Arras.    We have just found a British strongpoint that is blocking our way.    Take the lead and clear that up quickly, so we can maintain momentum and drive forward to the Channel Coast.
Be quiet... We should be close to the British lines. They can hear you.
Take them down quietly if possible. If they're here it means we're right next to the village.
Our objective is to secure Le Tôt - the village right next to us. After that, we will set up a bridgehead so our main force can arrive safely.
That's a British destroyer firing at us! They must have observers around here somewhere! We need to get rid of them!
Our main force has arrived. Now we are ready to push the remnants of the British forces back to the sea.
With enemy artillery observers watching our every move we cannot move out our tanks in the open. We need to send a small squad to eliminate the enemy forward observers and their radio operator.
After we make the enemy destroyer blind we will be able to use our tanks to neutralize enemy AA battery and call in our planes.
Gute arbeit Soldaten! I'm giving you control of our armored vehicles and tanks.
Enemy AA battery neutralized. The Luftwaffe is now ready to deal with the enemy destroyer once and for all.
Our howitzer battery has just arrived. You also have access to airstrikes now. Use both of them to sink that floating piece of junk!
Good hit! The destroyer is neutralized!
Soldaten! Time for the last push! Let's throw the Tommies off the cliff! Their morale is low but they still have some dangerous units in their reserves.
With the destroyer neutralized, the British soldiers had no chance of escaping! Secure their weapons, we've won another battle!
Scheiße... It's so foggy today. I can't see a thing.
What's that noise?... Sounds like artillery...
The enemy destroyer is targeting our troops! Move them quickly into cover before it fires!
One observer down! I think I see two more left!
Two observers down! There's only one left!
The Engländer surrender! They have nowhere to run!
Capture Le Tôt before the main force can arrive.
Eliminate enemy forward observers and radio operator to gain control of the tanks!
Eliminate the remnants of the British forces on the outskirts of St. Valery en Caux!
Another encirclement won, and a second Dunkirk prevented! Your leadership will surely get you nominated for an iron cross sooner or later. Well done!
Dammit, we should have eliminated this pocket easily; what went wrong? We should have beaten these demoralized allied troops easily, now they might get away to England!
Secret objective #1: Find a cave with hidden British equipment

The 7th Panzer, a.k.a. The “Ghost Division” passes Rouen on the 9th of June and makes for the coast the next day. Rushing to reach the coast, it has now closed the encirclement, successfully blocking the way out for several Allied divisions that are currently positioned in Valéry-en-Caux.    Once more, we have successfully encircled an allied army - or what’s left of it.   We can’t allow a second Dunkirk; you have to destroy the enemy before he has a chance to escape. Take the lead and advance immediately!
Soldaten! The day has come... The Allies are storming the beaches of France. We have to stop them and push them back into the sea. Our future relies on you today.
Their landing craft are in sight. Take one last minute to check your weapons and reinforce our weak points.
Another wave of landing craft incoming! Prepare yourself!
The British broke through on our right flank! Our defence is collapsing! Quick, reinforce the right flank before they swarm the town!
Soldaten! Our new objective is to take up positions inside the town and to stop the British from capturing it! You are allowed to tactically retreat to our second line!
We are not getting any support. We are the last stand in this area. Soldaten! Fall back to the Widerstandsnest!
There are Panzerfausts and anti-tank grenades in these crates! Take as many as you need to destroy the tanks!
Verdammt! What is that coming our way?! They have amphibious Panzers?!
Herr Kommandant! They are everywhere! And they've got even more tanks!
There's an armored vehicle that has been damaged by an artillery shell. We should repair it and put it back in action.
Herr Kommandant! We're gonna get overrun! Where are our reinforcements?!
Stop the invasion on the beach!
Do not let the enemy capture the town!
Hold the WN21! (at least 5 soldiers need to survive)

The Atlantikwall isn't supposed to fail, but it did! This beach is now firmly in British hands, when we should have thrown them all back into the sea. What went wrong, and what are you going to do about it?

It’s the early morning of June 6th, 1944. In the coastal town of Lion-sur-Mer, everything seems quiet. The Normandy beaches are empty except for barbed wire and obstacles. The coastal fortifications have never fired a single shot in anger yet.    After months of quiet anticipation and preparations, the silence is suddenly shattered by the horrifying sound of incoming shells, followed by a series of heavy explosions around your Atlantikwall position. Several allied cruisers have opened fire from a great distance, and the effect is devastating. Sound the alarm!    Is this the moment you’ve been preparing for in the past months?    Position WN 21, located just West of Lion-sur-Mer, gets pounded by a naval bombardment, and there’s nothing you can do about it, except wait until it’s over, and brace for the invasion.

They have already taken Saint-Pierre yesterday, which is east of Tilly-sur-Seulles. They have also occupied Hill 103 to the North-East of Tilly.   You and the Panzer Lehr division will be counterattacking toward the village of Tilly-sur-Seulles. The British currently hold it; we need to take it back before nightfall to prevent the allies from surrounding Caen.

That will show them! We have dealt the British a serious blow, and your leadership was a large part of this success. This opens up new possibilities to drive the Allies back onto the beaches, well done!

Who’s going to tell Field Marshal Rommel? This was our chance to breach the allied lines and push them back. Instead, British armor has broken through. Now we must plan a renewed attempt to stop them.
Mission failed - That borders on disaster!
You must hold your field HQ!

You need to attack! Use the superiority of your armor to achieve victory. Punch a hole through the British lines.
Be quick, be decisive, and try not to lose too many men! Use the terrain to your advantage.

Major! British are close to our Field HQ!
We must hold our command post! There is no room for surrender!
Major! Now you can request an artillery strike.

Secret objective #2: Hat Trick! - Downed three consecutive British fighters.
These arrogant Englishmen... They have no idea what they’re in for.
There's no time for that. Our reinforcements are on their way, we just need to cut the highway and delay them as long as we possibly can.
It seems like there's a gap between convoys. I don't see any more incoming vehicles. We should try to take over that manor across the highway, looks like a decent spot to hold. This is our chance.
Richtig. We have secured the manor and cut their lifeline. It won't be long before they come back. Our reinforcements should be here any moment now. Soldaten! Dig in and prepare to hold your ground!
We have been reinforced by some Grenadiere, they have set up a forward post by the highway.
More of our Kampfgruppe has just arrived from the West.
We've got some pretty strong guns with us now.
We've also got a radio vehicle and an artillery observer. If we lose him, we won't have artillery support anymore.
There are British and American units all around us, I'm sure they will want their highway back. Use the remaining time to set up defences. We must hold!
Keep the radio vehicle concealed, if it gets damaged we will lose access to artillery support.
We can’t hold them anymore. They've got too many tanks! We need to fall back and regroup..
Move all of your troops to the West we’re going out the way we came. There isn't much time left.
Verdammt... That column stretches farther than I can see... Trucks, tanks, everything...
Should we go back and report? Command should know they've got a lot of tanks.
They've got reinforcements! Vehicles approaching from the East!
It's getting darker... Something's moving in the distance! Panzer!
We are running out of ammo! We cannot hold them for too long! There's too many of them!
They don't even expect us. Marching like it's a parade.
They don't seem to be paying much attention at all. We should eliminate the patrols before we go in.
The Grenadiers have already dug their foxholes on the North-East flank. We should focus our defences around the main road.
Cut the highway and take control over the manor

Even though our initial strike was a success we couldn't hold against a massive amount of enemy armor. We had to retreat from this sector but the battle is not over yet. Now we are able to count our losses, regroup and strike the enemy even harder.

That’s a disappointment. Our last chance to cut the Allied spearhead has come and gone, and now the allies are likely to reach Arnhem after all. We should organize another attempt to take the road as soon as possible, failure is not an option!

A few days ago, the British paratroopers in Arnhem retreated South across the Rhine River, effectively putting an end to Operation Market Garden.    All that remains of the original plan is the salient around Highway 69 (Hell’s Highway), and the Allies are hanging on to it with everything they have.    Your unit is part of “Kampfgruppe Jungwirth”, which is in position near Koevering, ready to attack Highway 69.    If you succeed, the allies to the North will be trapped! Take the highway, and hold it!
Soldaten! The Canadians are not too far away from here and we are the only ones standing in their way to Walcheren.

Even the flooded fields are not stopping them... We are the first line of defence of Woensdrecht and Hoogerheide and we need to hold our current positions as long as possible to have time to prepare our main defences on the higher ground.
Do not allow the enemy to breach our line. Our main defences are not ready yet. Hold your positions along the roads going from East to West.

The Canadians are surely going to bring a lot of armor, you can find anti-tank and anti-personnel mines in the engineering trucks. Try to lay as many as possible on the roads going from South to North.
Good job. That should help us delay them.
They are coming on the left flank!
Our scouts are predicting we still have a couple of minutes before the enemy arrives. Use this time wisely. Strengthen our weak points and make sure we have anti-tank weapons pointing at every road.
They are taking a beating on the left flank but seems like they are starting a new attack on the right flank!
Take a look inside the boxes, you should find some grenades, explosives and panzerfausts there.
They are deploying more troops on both flanks!
We cannot hold the first line for much longer, or we'll be overrun. Our guns on the second line should be deployed already. Move your men back to strengthen the main defences.
We need to hold three strategic positions that ensure the Canadians can't break through. We have a couple of 8,8 cm guns and 10,5 cm howitzers, make use of them.
Enemy artillery barrage!! They likely know where our positions are now so take cover!
We cannot afford losing any more ground! Our mission is over, we are on the verge of ending up in another pocket. Holding Woensdrecht is impossible, now we have to fight for our lives.
The situation is falling apart quickly. The Allies are gaining ground. We must hold our positions for at least five more minutes so our command can reposition.
It never stops raining here. The mud is worse than in the East. At least there it froze.
They keep coming. Artillery, infantry and tanks. How much longer can we hold them back?
Do you believe that still matters? The Allies already have France. They have supplies, fuel... everything. Their logistics are much better than ours...
Survive… for what? Another pocket? Another retreat? Haven't we been through enough of that recently?
Clear! That must have been a resistance hideout. Let's see what else they've been hiding here.
A damaged howitzer? Why hasn't anyone repaired it yet?
Just like new! Now let's make use of it.
Don’t complain. Mud means tanks get stuck. And we need every advantage against those Canadians.
Until we’re ordered otherwise. That’s how it works. If we fail Walcheren will be open to the Allies and it’s the key to the Scheldt. As long as we remain here, Antwerp is useless to them
Better to keep your eyes on your section and your rifle ready than think of such things. That’s how you survive.
You survive for the man next to you. For the chance that we see home again. That’s enough for me...
Wait! I see someone with a weapon inside that house!
Let's take a few repairs kits and try to put this gun back in action. We will need it!

You have completed all mission objectives but this was a battle we couldn't win. With our determination we managed to slow down the Canadian attack just enough to regroup our forces and avoid even heavier losses.

Was that really all you could do? The Allies are now storming Walcheren peninsula, which means the harbor of Antwerp will be open to them very soon. You should organise a last ditch effort to undo this loss!

The Allies are still unable to use the harbor of Antwerp, and all of their supplies have to be brought in from Normandy by truck.    For this reason, the Canadians have started advancing in the direction of Woensdrecht today. They intend to gain access to the Zuid-Beveland peninsula and the Scheldt estuary.    You have been stationed at Hoogerheide, where you will stop them from breaking through to the peninsula. The stakes could not be higher!
The squad led by Lieutenant Arkady F. Aydinov could not establish control over the bridgehead.
To signal other troops, fire a flare at the pier. The squad leader has the flare gun in his inventory.
The Fascists brought in their vehicles! Use the full firepower of the gunboat and destroy them.
Scum! The nervedragging anti-tank guns here! Comrades, we must silence those guns immediately.
Well done, marines. A strong showing. Looks like the Germans didn't expect us. But we should not relax too early - they will surely try to retake this ground.
Here they come, the bastards. Didn't take them long. We must hold this line - the outcome of the operation depends on this very patch of land. Get to work, comrades.
Good work, boys - the lighthouse is secured. Now fire the flare and let the others know. They're likely already worried sick over there.
Let's go, comrades! We need to take that lighthouse and signal a flare - without it, no reinforcements will come. We won't last long standing in the open like this!
Germans are bringing more from the south! Best to leave a few men behind to cover the landing zone. We should not leave our rear uncovered.
The Germans are well dug in at the port. Our comrades will assault them, and they will need naval support. I placed one of our gunboats under your command. It's on the far side of the pier.
Get down! Enemy mortar fire incoming! Expect the Germans to charge as soon as the mortars stop firing!
Enemy aircraft! It's going straight for the gunboat - shoot it down immediately!
Heads up - aircraft incoming from the west! It's preparing to strike the gunboat!
Well done, comrades - the port is under our control now. Reinforcements should arrive at any moment.
Reinforcements have arrived - just in time. Let's use this short pause to prepare for the enemy's counterattack.

They're falling back! We've done it, comrades! We held the line - and showed the full strength of our Black Sea Fleet! Now our brothers in arms and families in Sevastopol have a real chance to stand strong!
Ouch! That is not the outcome Stavka planned. You don’t want this reported to HQ. Maybe you should try again?
Lt. Aydinov's landing party, Soviet Black Sea Fleet

You are going on a mission to support besieged Sevastopol. To be precise, you are ordered to secure the Crimean harbor of Feodosiya for the large invasion force that will land there. We will go ashore behind the enemy’s back, and you will be in the first echelon.  This attack will relieve pressure on Sevastopol for sure, when the Germans have to turn around and fight us in Feodosiya; the importance of this mission cannot be overstated.  The success of your mission depends on your improvisation skills and the ability to use every bit of equipment you come across.   Good luck!

While the 1st Belorussian Front is smashing through Army Group Centre during Operation Bagration in the summer of 1944, you are advancing behind the main line of attack. Your orders are clear: report to the headquarters of the 17th Infantry Division.  As you move through the humid Belarusian countryside under a grey July sky, you wonder what the division staff needs from you. You’ll know soon enough. Just keep marching — the HQ is just beyond that village up ahead.   Good luck!
Put the documents into Dietrich Hellmann's inventory to continue.
Put the chicken steak into one of the boxes near the field kitchen.
I am quite hungry. Should we maybe bring this meat to our field kitchen for later?
Let's see... I can't make out all the details, but even at a first glance, the news is grim. Discouraging, I'd say.
They've surrounded our division and plan to attack it from two directions. There is more bad news - they've got heavy tanks!
The situation calls for guts and determination. We must ambush their reinforcements and warn our comrades!
Now they know we're here. In a moment, the whole village will be looking for us. Prepare yourselves!
I think that was the last of them. Amazing job, soldiers!
Let's get out of here. We need to warn our comrades.
We're almost there. The 17th Division HQ should be somewhere nearby.
These places are so beautiful... Aren't they?
What do you think? Will the 17th Division be glad to see us?
A soviet tank? Mein Gott! It's a trap!
I'll tell you what's going on. Partisans in German uniforms are taking our comrades prisoner.
Don't panic. Let's think. I assume you don't want to join the guys with raised hands?

First of all, let's keep quiet for some time. The Soviets outnumber us, and they have much better equipment. We must find a gap in their defense and use their weapons against them. Once they spot us, the whole village will attack us.
Secondly, we have to free our men. We can't let them die here.

And another thing: I saw a Soviet officer with a briefcase in this village. I wouldn't mind taking a look at the papers inside. They could explain why Russians control this village. I need to be the one to read those documents, since I am the only one in the squad who understands Russian.
Outstanding work, soldiers. Armor like that will take us all the way to Moscow. But be careful with it, this beast is the only one we've got.
Good day, men. We thought you could use some help. You are now temporarily under my command.
What did I tell you guys? This dinner was indeed worth the hunt! Just like the good old days!
What a surprise. I didn't expect to see them so soon on the Ostfront. If we capture and repair this vehicle, it will give us a huge advantage.
Hey you, leave your cars and come over here with your hands up!
Look! There are some papers here...
Watch out, they have reinforcements coming from the north!
Watch out, they have reinforcements approaching from the west!
I can't argue with that... It reminds me of my village.
What the hell is going on there?
Damn them! And I thought that the front line was twenty kilometers from here!
Hauptmann Hellmann, look! The Russians have something that is rightfully ours.
Hauptmann Hellmann was killed! We need to get out of here now!
Congratulations, you did it! You showed great improvisation skills here. Your actions today will surely get you promoted. Well done!
That was not what we planned for. You’ll have to regroup, go in again, and try different tactics; giving up is not an option for our captured friends.
Recover and analyze the Soviet HQ documents

The loudspeaker on the Sherman can be used to raise the morale of our troops by playing music.
Well, the weather turned out nice today. Everyone is out and about, not a single fascist or villager has noticed us coming.
The trucks are all going to the center of town. Too many fascists.
You have a death wish. The Germans are retreating. We want them gone, but don't have to kill them; they will run away soon enough. What are you playing?
Tigers are on the menu today!
So, comrade tank commander, what secret weapon do you have to catch the Tigers from behind, huh? Maybe we can all be blown to pieces as bait while you get your shit together?
Is that solid gold? And they've hoarded truckloads of that in town? How are we going to get it out?
That is... a lot of gold!
The trucks have arrived, we will begin loading them. The warehouse needs protecting until we're all done.
Fascists incoming! Comrades, defend the trucks!
Well comrades, I have the distinct sensation that the war ends here and now for me. I hope not to see you again too soon, but it was an honor to liberate the motherland with you all these years.
Yup, but the Germans are all over the place. Trucks are going in but not coming out. Something about this stinks! We need to find out what the fascists are hoarding here.
Hmm. It looks like one of those trucks broke down up ahead. I say we take a look at their cargo.
My friend, this goes beyond liberating our country from the fascist yoke. The Germans are taking valuables with them. This particular convoy seems heavily protected.

Don't panic. The Tigers are vulnerable in close quarters. We'll outflank them and attack them from behind. Whatever they are safeguarding in this town must be very valuable if tigers are strolling around.
Well, well. Now that's something worth guarding with Tigers.
Comrade, do you know anyone who can help us extract these valuables?

I checked the documents in the vehicle and they were heading towards the farmers' warehouse in the center of town. It makes sense; it's a large building. That is where we will find our treasure. Let's move out!

Yeah, well, this gold is useless unless we can get it out of here. The Germans clearly want to take it with them, so we need to act swiftly. Secure the village! Comrade tank commander, call your friends up.
Comrades, I need a thorough search. I don't want a single fascist left in this village compromising our operation. We need those trucks coming in safe and sound.
Damn it! We failed to clear the town!
Comrades, set up a defensive perimeter around the warehouse! The gold will take time to load, and the Germans will want it back!
No! We've lost too many transport trucks!
Spread out and take ambush positions!
We don't have supplies. I wonder whether we should look out for German supply convoys. At least one of them will be bound to be retreating westward.
Comrade tank commander. The uniforms and the weaponry, I do understand. But is there a particular reason to take a Tiger tank with you too?
The fuel system is junk. It smells of fuel a mile away. The transmission is falling to pieces. You have no spare parts and huge German markings to attract friendly fire!
Now then. Tell me, comrades, what's on the menu today? How can the glorious Red Army be of assistance?
Oh man... nobody said anything about them Tigers!
Always with the pessimistic attitude, Iosif... I'll tell you what we do. We have a loudspeaker, and when we go into battle, we like to play music very loud... it kind of calms us down.
Alright, let's find out what those Fascists have got. My guys here in the back are ready.
Comrade Partisan, Always with the pessimistic attitude. Can't you enjoy the fact you just became rich? Why don't you let me organise a pickup?

Sure thing. Let's find out where the Fascists keep the gold, clear the area, and I'm sure I could persuade some comrades to come along with transports. The war has been very tough on all of us. The thought of returning to the Urals emptyhanded seems rather sad, you know?
(on radio) No, I'm not trying to be funny. Listen, I need a favour. How soon can you come here with, say... 10 empty trucks?
(on radio) Listen, I need you here round about now, I'm about to cut you into a very good deal, if you don't want it, then you're out, I can find 10 trucks almost anywhere.
Yeah, just as I thought. Alright, comrades, listen up! 6 minutes for our trucks to come from the southeast, secure the town!
Alright, comrades, I have gotten us some air support over my portable radio. It seems our air force guys have nothing better to do than accept tasking from a low-life tank driver.
Alright, here goes nothing, let's see what our planes can do!
Calling in an IL-2. One thousand seven hundred horsepowers of goodness and some big bombs strapped under it.
Why is everyone so damn negative around here? Can't we just take a moment to delight ourselves with the prize we have collected?
Great job! Who would ever have thought you’d emerge a millionaire? This victory is proof that you should never let them negative waves win.
What happened? Did you not watch the 1970 movie Kelly’s Heroes? Watch it, and try again.
Elements of the Yugoslav People's Liberation Army
